title: Fast Path Planning for Autonomous Vehicle Parking with Safety-Guarantee using Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability
comments: accepted by IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary: We present a fast planning architecture called Hamilton-Jacobi-based bidirectional A* (HJBA*) to solve general tight parking scenarios. The algorithm is a two-layer composed of a high-level HJ-based reachability analysis and a lower-level bidirectional A* search algorithm. In high-level reachability analysis, a backward reachable tube (BRT) concerning vehicle dynamics is computed by the HJ analysis and it intersects with a safe set to get a safe reachable set. The safe set is defined by constraints of positive signed distances for obstacles in the environment and computed by solving QP optimization problems offline. For states inside the intersection set, i.e., the safe reachable set, the computed backward reachable tube ensures they are reachable subjected to system dynamics and input bounds, and the safe set guarantees they satisfy parking safety with respect to obstacles in different shapes. For online computation, randomized states are sampled from the safe reachable set, and used as heuristic guide points to be considered in the bidirectional A* search. The bidirectional A* search is paralleled for each randomized state from the safe reachable set. We show that the proposed two-level planning algorithm is able to solve different parking scenarios effectively and computationally fast for typical parking requests. We validate our algorithm through simulations in large-scale randomized parking scenarios and demonstrate it to be able to outperform other state-of-the-art parking planning algorithms.
comment: accepted by IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology

AI.title_translation: 基于Hamilton-Jacobi可达性的自动驾驶泊车快速路径规划与安全保证
AI.tldr: 为了快速安全地完成自动驾驶泊车，我们用HJ分析预先计算出保证动态和环境安全的“安全可达集”，然后用这个集合来指导一个快速的并行双向A*搜索，结果表明该方法比现有方法更快、更有效。
AI.motivation: 解决一般性、紧凑的自动驾驶泊车场景的快速规划问题，并确保规划的安全性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为基于Hamilton-Jacobi的双向A*（HJBA*）的快速规划架构，该架构由高层基于HJ的可达性分析和低层双向A*搜索组成。高层分析计算后向可达管（BRT），并与由离线QP优化定义的安全集相交，得到安全可达集。在线搜索时，从安全可达集中随机采样状态作为启发式引导点，并行地指导双向A*搜索。
AI.result: 所提出的HJBA*算法能够有效地解决不同的泊车场景，并且在计算上速度很快，在大型随机泊车场景的仿真中，其性能优于其他最先进的泊车规划算法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的双层规划算法（HJBA*）能够有效且快速地解决典型的泊车请求，并在大规模随机泊车场景的仿真中表现出优于现有最先进泊车规划算法的性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种名为基于Hamilton-Jacobi的双向A*（HJBA*）的快速规划架构，用于解决一般的紧凑泊车场景。该算法由两层组成，包括高层的基于HJ的可达性分析和低层的双向A*搜索算法。在高层可达性分析中，通过HJ分析计算出关于车辆动力学的后向可达管（BRT），并与安全集相交得到安全可达集。安全集是通过求解离线二次规划（QP）优化问题定义的，它由障碍物正符号距离约束组成。对于处于交集中的状态，即安全可达集中的状态，计算出的后向可达管确保了它们在系统动力学和输入约束下是可达的，而安全集保证了它们相对于不同形状障碍物的泊车安全性。对于在线计算，从安全可达集中随机采样状态，并用作启发式引导点，以供双向A*搜索考虑。双向A*搜索针对从安全可达集中采样的每个随机状态进行并行化。我们证明了所提出的双层规划算法能够有效且计算快速地解决典型的泊车请求中的不同泊车场景。我们通过大规模随机泊车场景的仿真验证了我们的算法，并证明它能够超越其他最先进的泊车规划算法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为HJBA*的两层快速泊车路径规划架构，它结合了高层的Hamilton-Jacobi（HJ）可达性分析（用于生成保证动态和安全约束的安全可达集）和低层的并行双向A*搜索。高层分析预先计算安全约束，低层搜索利用安全集中采样的点作为启发式引导，从而实现快速且安全地解决自动驾驶泊车问题。
AI.keywords: 快速路径规划, 自动驾驶泊车, Hamilton-Jacobi, 双向A*, 可达性分析
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地结合了Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析和双向A*搜索，以快速且安全地解决自动驾驶泊车问题。其主要优势在于通过预先计算的后向可达管（BRT）和安全集来保证规划的安全性，并利用随机采样点加速在线搜索。局限性在于对车辆动力学模型的准确性依赖，以及预计算安全集的计算复杂度。

title: Polarimetric Light Transport Analysis for Specular Inter-reflection
comments: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging (TCI)
summary: Polarization is well known for its ability to decompose diffuse and specular reflections. However, the existing decomposition methods only focus on direct reflection and overlook multiple reflections, especially specular inter-reflection. In this paper, we propose a novel decomposition method for handling specular inter-reflection of metal objects by using a unique polarimetric feature: the rotation direction of linear polarization. This rotation direction serves as a discriminative factor between direct and inter-reflection on specular surfaces. To decompose the reflectance components, we actively rotate the linear polarization of incident light and analyze the rotation direction of the reflected light. We evaluate our method using both synthetic and real data, demonstrating its effectiveness in decomposing specular inter-reflections of metal objects. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method can be combined with other decomposition methods for a detailed analysis of light transport. As a practical application, we show its effectiveness in improving the accuracy of 3D measurement against strong specular inter-reflection.
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Computational Imaging (TCI)

AI.title_translation: 用于镜面间反射的偏振光传输分析
AI.tldr: 利用旋转方向区分直接反射和镜面间反射的偏振光分解新方法，有效解决了金属物体多重反射问题，提高了3D测量精度。
AI.motivation: 现有的反射分解方法只关注直接反射，忽略了多重反射，特别是镜面间反射。偏振光虽然能分解漫反射和镜面反射，但需要解决处理镜面间反射的问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的分解方法，利用线性偏振光的旋转方向作为区分直接反射和间反射的判别因素。通过主动旋转入射光的线性偏振并分析反射光的旋转方向来进行反射分量的分解。
AI.result: 我们使用合成数据和真实数据评估了该方法，证明了其在分解金属物体镜面间反射方面的有效性。我们还展示了该方法可以与其他分解方法结合，用于详细的光传输分析，并在提高3D测量精度方面显示出有效性。
AI.conclusion: 我们证明了该方法在分离金属物体的镜面间反射方面的有效性，并且可以与其他分解方法结合以进行详细的光传输分析。在实际应用中，我们展示了它在提高3D测量精度方面的有效性。
AI.translation: 偏振光以其分解漫反射和镜面反射的能力而闻名。然而，现有的分解方法只关注直接反射，而忽略了多次反射，特别是镜面间反射。在本文中，我们提出了一种新颖的分解方法，利用独特的偏振特征——线性偏振的旋转方向——来处理金属物体的镜面间反射。该旋转方向作为镜面上的直接反射和间反射之间的判别因子。为了分解反射分量，我们主动旋转入射光的线性偏振并分析反射光的旋转方向。我们使用合成数据和真实数据评估了我们的方法，证明了其在分解金属物体镜面间反射方面的有效性。此外，我们还展示了我们的方法可以与其他分解方法结合，以进行详细的光传输分析。在实际应用中，我们展示了它在提高3D测量精度方面对抗强镜面间反射的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的偏振光分解方法，专门用于处理金属物体的镜面间反射。该方法利用了线性偏振光的旋转方向这一独特特征，该方向可以区分直接反射和间反射。通过主动控制入射光的偏振并分析反射光的旋转方向，实现了反射分量的精确分解，并在3D测量精度提升方面展示了其实用价值。
AI.keywords: 偏振光, 镜面间反射, 反射分解, 线性偏振, 金属物体
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地利用了线性偏振光的旋转方向作为区分直接反射和镜面间反射的关键特征，解决了现有方法忽略多重反射的局限性，尤其适用于金属物体。其重要性在于提高了复杂光照条件下（尤其是存在强镜面间反射时）反射分量的精确分离能力。限制是目前主要关注金属物体。

title: MatSegNet: a New Boundary-aware Deep Learning Model for Accurate Carbide Precipitate Analysis in High-Strength Steels
summary: Lower Bainite (LB) and Tempered Martensite (TM) are two common microstructures in modern high-strength steels. LB and TM can render similar mechanical properties for steels, yet LB is often considered superior to TM in resistance to hydrogen embrittlement. Such performance difference has conventionally been attributed to their distinction in certain microstructural features, particularly carbides. The present study developed, MatSegNet, a new contour-aware deep learning (DL) architecture. It is tailored for comprehensive segmentation and quantitative characterization of carbide precipitates with complex contours in high-strength steels, shown to outperform existing state-of-the-art DL architectures. Based on MatSegNet, a high-throughput DL pipeline has been established for precise comparative carbide analysis in LB and TM. The results showed that statistically the two microstructures exhibit similarity in key carbide characteristics with marginal difference, cautioning against the conventional use of carbide orientation as a reliable means to differentiate LB and TM in practice. Through MatSegNet, this work demonstrated the potential of DL to play a critical role in enabling accurate and quantitative microstructure characterization to facilitate development of structure-property relationships for accelerating materials innovation.

AI.title_translation: 高强度钢中用于精确碳化物析出分析的新型边界感知深度学习模型：MatSegNet
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了MatSegNet，一种用于高强度钢中碳化物析出的边界感知深度学习模型，并建立了一个高通量分析流程，发现LB和TM在碳化物特征上相似，对传统区分方法提出质疑。
AI.motivation: 区分下贝氏体（LB）和回火马氏体（TM）在现代高强度钢中的微观结构，特别是碳化物析出特征，因为这两种微观结构在力学性能上相似，但LB在抗氢脆性方面优于TM。
AI.method: 开发了一种名为MatSegNet的新型边界感知深度学习（DL）架构，用于分割和表征高强度钢中具有复杂轮廓的碳化物析出物，并建立了一个高通量DL流程进行LB和TM的精确比较碳化物分析。
AI.result: 通过MatSegNet进行的高通量分析表明，LB和TM在关键碳化物特征上表现出统计学上的相似性，差异很小，这提示在实践中不能仅依靠碳化物取向来区分这两种微观结构。
AI.conclusion: 本研究开发的MatSegNet模型能够准确地表征碳化物析出物，并揭示了LB和TM在碳化物特征上的相似性，挑战了传统上仅凭碳化物取向来区分这两种微观结构的观点，强调了深度学习在材料结构-性能关系研究中的潜力。
AI.translation: 低贝氏体（LB）和回火马氏体（TM）是现代高强度钢的两种常见微观结构。LB和TM可以使钢材具有相似的力学性能，但LB通常被认为在抗氢脆性方面优于TM。这种性能差异传统上归因于它们在某些微观结构特征上的区别，特别是碳化物。本研究开发了一种名为MatSegNet的新型轮廓感知深度学习（DL）架构。它专门用于全面分割和定量表征高强度钢中具有复杂轮廓的碳化物析出物，并被证明优于现有的最先进的DL架构。基于MatSegNet，建立了一个高通量DL流程，用于LB和TM中精确的比较碳化物分析。结果表明，统计学上这两种微观结构在关键碳化物特征上表现出相似性，差异很小，这提示在实践中不能仅仅依靠碳化物取向来区分LB和TM。通过MatSegNet，这项工作展示了DL在实现准确和定量的微观结构表征方面的潜力，以促进结构-性能关系的建立，从而加速材料创新。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为MatSegNet的新型边界感知深度学习模型，用于精确分析高强度钢中的碳化物析出物。该模型能够有效分割和表征具有复杂轮廓的碳化物，并且优于现有技术。基于MatSegNet建立的高通量分析流程，对低贝氏体（LB）和回火马氏体（TM）进行了比较分析，结果显示两者在关键碳化物特征上无显著差异，对传统依靠碳化物取向区分这两种微观结构的方法提出了挑战。该研究展示了深度学习在材料微观结构定量表征和加速材料创新方面的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: MatSegNet, 碳化物析出, 深度学习, 微观结构分析, 高强度钢
AI.comments: 该研究提出的MatSegNet模型在碳化物析出分析方面具有创新性，其边界感知能力对于处理复杂轮廓的析出物尤为重要。该研究结果对材料科学领域具有重要意义，因为它挑战了传统上区分LB和TM的观点，并强调了深度学习在加速材料研发中的作用。然而，模型的泛化能力和在不同类型钢材上的应用效果有待进一步验证。

title: WiFi-GEN: High-Resolution Indoor Imaging from WiFi Signals Using Generative AI
summary: Indoor imaging is a critical task for robotics and internet-ofthings. WiFi as an omnipresent signal is a promising candidate for carrying out passive imaging and synchronizing the up-to-date information to all connected devices. This is the first research work to consider WiFi indoor imaging as a multi-modal image generation task that converts the measured WiFi power into a high-resolution indoor image. Our proposedWiFi-GEN network achieves a shape reconstruction accuracy that is 275% of that achieved by physical model-based inversion methods. Additionally, the Frechet Inception Distance score has been significantly reduced by 82%. To examine the effectiveness of models for this task, the first large-scale dataset is released containing 80,000 pairs of WiFi signal and imaging target. Our model absorbs challenges for the model-based methods including the nonlinearity, ill-posedness and non-certainty into massive parameters of our generative AI network. The network is also designed to best fit measured WiFi signals and the desired imaging output. Code: https://github.com/CNFightingSjy/WiFiGEN

AI.title_translation: WiFi-GEN：利用生成式AI从WiFi信号进行高分辨率室内成像
AI.tldr: 研究人员使用一个名为WiFi-GEN的生成式AI模型，首次实现了从无处不在的WiFi信号中生成高分辨率室内图像，其性能远超传统物理方法，并发布了首个大规模数据集。
AI.motivation: 室内成像对机器人和物联网至关重要，而无处不在的WiFi信号是实现被动成像和同步信息的有前景的候选。
AI.method: 提出WiFi-GEN网络，将测量的WiFi功率转换为高分辨率室内图像，将其视为一个多模态图像生成任务，并通过生成式AI网络吸收了模型方法的挑战（非线性、病态和不确定性）。
AI.result: WiFi-GEN在形状重建精度上达到了基于物理模型的反演方法的275%。弗雷歇初始距离（FID）分数显著降低了82%。发布了包含80,000对WiFi信号和成像目标的第一个大规模数据集。
AI.translation: 室内成像对于机器人技术和物联网至关重要。WiFi作为一种无处不在的信号，是执行被动成像并将最新信息同步到所有连接设备的有希望的候选者。这是第一项将WiFi室内成像视为多模态图像生成任务的研究工作，该任务将测量的WiFi功率转换为高分辨率室内图像。我们提出的WiFi-GEN网络实现的形状重建精度是基于物理模型的反演方法所达到精度的275%。此外，弗雷歇初始距离（FID）分数显著降低了82%。为了检验模型在此任务上的有效性，我们发布了第一个包含80,000对WiFi信号和成像目标的大规模数据集。我们的模型吸收了模型方法面临的挑战，包括非线性和病态性，通过我们生成式AI网络的大量参数来实现。该网络也被设计为最适合拟合测量的WiFi信号和所需的成像输出。代码：https://github.com/CNFightingSjy/WiFiGEN
AI.summary: WiFi-GEN是一项开创性的研究，首次将基于WiFi信号的室内成像视为多模态图像生成任务，利用生成式AI网络将测量的WiFi功率转换为高分辨率图像。该方法显著优于基于物理模型的反演方法，并在形状重建精度和图像质量（FID分数）上取得了大幅提升，同时发布了一个大规模的WiFi成像数据集。
AI.keywords: WiFi成像, 室内成像, 生成式AI, 图像生成, WiFi-GEN
AI.comments: 这项工作的新颖之处在于首次将WiFi信号重建为高分辨率图像视为一个多模态图像生成任务，并利用生成式AI（WiFi-GEN）来克服传统物理模型方法的局限性（非线性、病态和不确定性）。其性能提升非常显著。数据集的发布也是一项重要贡献。

title: Towards Urban General Intelligence: A Review and Outlook of Urban Foundation Models
summary: The integration of machine learning techniques has become a cornerstone in the development of intelligent urban services, significantly contributing to the enhancement of urban efficiency, sustainability, and overall livability. Recent advancements in foundational models, such as ChatGPT, have introduced a paradigm shift within the fields of machine learning and artificial intelligence. These models, with their exceptional capacity for contextual comprehension, problem-solving, and task adaptability, present a transformative opportunity to reshape the future of smart cities and drive progress toward Urban General Intelligence (UGI). Despite increasing attention to Urban Foundation Models (UFMs), this rapidly evolving field faces critical challenges, including the lack of clear definitions, systematic reviews, and universalizable solutions. To address these issues, this paper first introduces the definition and concept of UFMs and highlights the distinctive challenges involved in their development. Furthermore, we present a data-centric taxonomy that classifies existing research on UFMs according to the various urban data modalities and types. In addition, we propose a prospective framework designed to facilitate the realization of versatile UFMs, aimed at overcoming the identified challenges and driving further progress in this field. Finally, this paper systematically summarizes and discusses existing benchmarks and datasets related to UFMs, and explores the wide-ranging applications of UFMs within urban contexts, illustrating their potential to significantly impact and transform urban systems. A comprehensive collection of relevant research papers and open-source resources have been collated and are continuously updated at: https://github.com/usail-hkust/Awesome-Urban-Foundation-Models.

AI.title_translation: 迈向城市通用智能：城市基础模型的回顾与展望
AI.tldr: 城市基础模型（UFM）是智能城市发展的未来，但该领域尚不成熟。本文定义了UFM，根据数据类型对其进行了分类，并提出了一个实现通用UFM并克服当前挑战的未来路线图，同时总结了现有资源和应用前景。
AI.motivation: 鉴于基础模型（如ChatGPT）在机器学习和人工智能领域带来的范式转变，以及它们在重塑智能城市和推动城市通用智能（UGI）方面的变革性潜力，但目前该领域缺乏清晰的定义、系统的综述和普遍适用的解决方案，因此需要对UFM进行梳理和展望。
AI.method: 本文首先介绍了UFM的定义和概念，突出了其发展中面临的独特挑战。然后，作者提出了一个以数据为中心的分类法，根据不同的城市数据模态和类型对现有UFM研究进行分类。此外，还提出了一个前瞻性框架，旨在促进通用UFM的实现。最后，对现有基准、数据集和应用进行了系统总结和讨论。
AI.result: 介绍了UFM的定义、挑战，提出了一个数据驱动的UFM研究分类法，并提出了一个实现通用UFM的前瞻性框架，同时总结了相关基准、数据集和广泛应用。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统地总结和讨论了与UFM相关的现有基准和数据集，并探讨了UFM在城市环境中的广泛应用，展示了它们对城市系统产生重大影响和变革的潜力。
AI.translation: 机器学习技术的融合已成为发展智能城市服务的基石，极大地促进了城市效率、可持续性和整体宜居性的提升。基础模型（如ChatGPT）的最新进展在机器学习和人工智能领域带来了范式转变。这些模型凭借其卓越的上下文理解、问题解决和任务适应能力，为重塑智慧城市的未来和推动城市通用智能（UGI）的进步提供了变革性的机遇。尽管对城市基础模型（UFM）的关注日益增加，但这一快速发展的领域面临着关键挑战，包括缺乏明确的定义、系统性的回顾和普遍适用的解决方案。为解决这些问题，本文首先介绍了UFM的定义和概念，并强调了其发展中涉及的独特挑战。此外，我们提出了一个以数据为中心的分类法，根据各种城市数据模态和类型对现有的UFM研究进行分类。此外，我们提出了一个旨在促进通用UFM实现的、前瞻性的框架，旨在克服已确定的挑战并推动该领域的进一步发展。最后，本文系统地总结和讨论了与UFM相关的现有基准和数据集，并探讨了UFM在城市环境中的广泛应用，阐明了它们对城市系统产生重大影响和变革的潜力。相关研究论文和开源资源的综合集合已整理并在：https://github.com/usail-hkust/Awesome-Urban-Foundation-Models 持续更新。
AI.summary: 本文对快速发展的城市基础模型（UFM）领域进行了综述和展望，旨在推动城市通用智能（UGI）的发展。文章首先定义了UFM并讨论了其面临的挑战，随后提出了一个基于城市数据模态和类型的分类法来组织现有研究。最后，文章提出了一个实现通用UFM的前瞻性框架，并总结了相关的基准、数据集和潜在应用。
AI.keywords: 城市基础模型, 城市通用智能, 智能城市, 数据驱动分类法, 基础模型
AI.comments: 这项工作的重要创新在于首次系统性地定义了城市基础模型（UFM），并提出了一个数据驱动的分类法来组织现有研究，同时展望了实现通用城市智能（UGI）的未来框架，填补了该领域的理论和综述空白。局限性在于它是一篇综述性工作，主要关注现有研究的梳理和未来方向的提出。

title: Scene Prior Filtering for Depth Super-Resolution
summary: Multi-modal fusion serves as a cornerstone for successful depth map super-resolution. However, commonly used fusion strategies, such as addition and concatenation, fall short of effectively bridging the modal gap. As a result, guided image filtering methods have been introduced to mitigate this issue. Nevertheless, it is observed that their filter kernels usually encounter significant texture interference and edge inaccuracy. To tackle these two challenges, we introduce a Scene Prior Filtering network, SPFNet, which utilizes the priors' surface normal and semantic map from large-scale models. Specifically, we propose an All-in-one Prior Propagation that computes similarity between multi-modal scene priors, i.e., RGB, normal, semantic, and depth, to reduce the texture interference. Besides, we design a One-to-one Prior Embedding that continuously embeds every single modal prior into depth using Mutual Guided Filtering, further alleviating texture interference while enhancing edge representations. Our SPFNet has been extensively evaluated on both real-world and synthetic datasets, achieving state-of-the-art performance.

AI.title_translation: 用于深度超分辨率的场景先验滤波
AI.tldr: 为了解决深度图超分辨率中多模态融合的模态鸿沟和滤波器的纹理/边缘问题，我们提出了SPFNet，它使用法线和语义图作为先验，通过新的传播和嵌入机制来优化深度图的重建，结果达到了SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的多模态融合策略（如加法和拼接）难以有效弥合模态鸿沟；已有的引导图像滤波方法常遭遇严重的纹理干扰和边缘不准确问题。需要一种新的方法来解决这些挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为场景先验滤波网络（SPFNet）的方法，该网络利用来自大型模型的表面法线和语义图作为先验。具体来说，提出了“一体化先验传播”（All-in-one Prior Propagation）来计算多模态场景先验（RGB、法线、语义和深度）之间的相似性以减少纹理干扰；设计了“一对一先验嵌入”（One-to-one Prior Embedding）通过互导滤波（Mutual Guided Filtering）将每个单独的模态先验连续嵌入到深度图中，以减轻纹理干扰并增强边缘表示。
AI.result: SPFNet 实现了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: SPFNet 在真实世界和合成数据集上进行了广泛评估，实现了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 多模态融合是成功实现深度图超分辨率的基石。然而，常用的融合策略，如加法和拼接，在有效弥合模态鸿沟方面存在不足。因此，人们引入了引导图像滤波方法来缓解这个问题。然而，观察到它们的滤波器核通常会遇到严重的纹理干扰和边缘不准确。为了解决这两个挑战，我们引入了场景先验滤波网络（SPFNet），该网络利用来自大型模型的先验的表面法线和语义图。具体来说，我们提出了“一体化先验传播”，计算多模态场景先验，即RGB、法线、语义和深度之间的相似性，以减少纹理干扰。此外，我们设计了“一对一先验嵌入”，通过互导滤波将每个单独的模态先验连续嵌入到深度图中，进一步减轻纹理干扰，同时增强边缘表示。我们的SPFNet在真实世界和合成数据集上都经过了广泛评估，取得了最先进的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为场景先验滤波网络（SPFNet）的新方法，用于深度图超分辨率，旨在解决传统多模态融合方法中存在的纹理干扰和边缘不准确问题。SPFNet利用表面法线和语义图作为场景先验，通过“一体化先验传播”机制减少纹理干扰，并通过“一对一先验嵌入”机制结合互导滤波来增强边缘表示。实验证明，该方法在真实和合成数据集上均达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 深度超分辨率, 场景先验, 多模态融合, 边缘表示, 纹理干扰
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于引入了场景先验信息（法线和语义图）来指导深度图超分辨率过程，并提出了两种新颖的先验处理机制（All-in-one Prior Propagation 和 One-to-one Prior Embedding）来解决传统方法中存在的纹理干扰和边缘不准确问题。其重要性在于为解决多模态融合中的模态鸿沟提供了新的有效途径。局限性在于其性能高度依赖于预先提取的先验图的质量。

title: Asymptotically and Minimax Optimal Regret Bounds for Multi-Armed Bandits with Abstention
summary: We introduce a novel extension of the canonical multi-armed bandit problem that incorporates an additional strategic innovation: abstention. In this enhanced framework, the agent is not only tasked with selecting an arm at each time step, but also has the option to abstain from accepting the stochastic instantaneous reward before observing it. When opting for abstention, the agent either suffers a fixed regret or gains a guaranteed reward. This added layer of complexity naturally prompts the key question: can we develop algorithms that are both computationally efficient and asymptotically and minimax optimal in this setting? We answer this question in the affirmative by designing and analyzing algorithms whose regrets meet their corresponding information-theoretic lower bounds. Our results offer valuable quantitative insights into the benefits of the abstention option, laying the groundwork for further exploration in other online decision-making problems with such an option. Extensive numerical experiments validate our theoretical results, demonstrating that our approach not only advances theory but also has the potential to deliver significant practical benefits.

AI.title_translation: 关于带弃权的多臂老虎机的渐近和最小最大最优遗憾界
AI.tldr: 研究人员在多臂老虎机中加入了“弃权”选项，并成功设计了能达到理论最优（渐近和最小最大最优）遗憾的算法，证明弃权策略是有益的。
AI.motivation: 在经典的“多臂老虎机”问题中引入了一个新的战略创新——“弃权”选项，即代理人可以选择在观察到随机瞬时奖励之前放弃接受它。这引发了设计计算高效且在渐近和最小最大意义上都最优的算法的关键问题。
AI.method: 通过设计和分析新的算法，使其遗憾界限达到相应的信息论下界。此外，还进行了广泛的数值实验来验证理论结果。
AI.result: 设计并分析的算法的遗憾界限达到了相应的信息论下界，证明了可以在引入弃权选项的情况下实现渐近最优和最小最大最优的性能。数值实验验证了这些理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计和分析算法，证明了在引入弃权选项的多臂老虎机问题中，可以实现渐近最优和最小最大最优的遗憾界限。研究结果为弃权选项的收益提供了量化见解，并为其他具有此类选项的在线决策问题奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 我们介绍了一种对经典多臂老虎机问题的创新扩展，该扩展包含一个额外的战略创新：弃权。在这个增强的框架中，代理人不仅需要在每个时间步选择一个臂，而且还有在观察到随机瞬时奖励之前放弃接受它的选项。当选择弃权时，代理人要么遭受固定的遗憾，要么获得有保证的奖励。这种增加的复杂性自然引发了一个关键问题：我们能否在这种设置中开发出计算高效且在渐近和最小最大意义上都最优的算法？我们以肯定的方式回答了这个问题，设计并分析了其遗憾达到相应信息论下界的算法。我们的结果为弃权选项的收益提供了宝贵的定量见解，为在具有此类选项的其他在线决策问题中进行进一步探索奠定了基础。广泛的数值实验验证了我们的理论结果，证明了我们的方法不仅推进了理论，而且有潜力带来显著的实际好处。
AI.summary: 本文将“弃权”策略扩展到多臂老虎机问题，代理人可以选择在获取奖励前放弃。研究人员设计并分析了满足信息论下限的算法，证明了在引入弃权选项的情况下可以实现渐近和最小最大最优的遗憾界限，并提供了弃权选项益处的量化见解。
AI.keywords: 多臂老虎机, 弃权, 遗憾界, 最小最大最优, 渐近最优
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将“弃权”策略引入到经典的“多臂老虎机”问题中，这增加了一个新的决策维度。其重要性在于证明了在引入弃权选项后，仍然可以设计出渐近最优和最小最大最优的算法，为在线决策问题中的类似策略提供了理论基础。摘要中未明确提及局限性。

title: Mechanism for Collaborative Federated Learning: Pitfalls of Shapley Values
summary: This paper investigates the impact of mechanism design on collaborative learning systems enabled by federated learning (FL). We propose a multi-action collaborative federated learning (MCFL) framework, capturing the interplay between agent strategies, platform mechanisms, and FL algorithms--a "three-body problem" in collaborative learning. This work demonstrates how the convergence rate and computational efficiency of FL are endogenously determined by the agent participation equilibrium that is induced by the mechanism. By doing so, we establish a direct link between incentive design in collaborative learning systems and the performance of the underlying optimization algorithms, a connection that has been largely overlooked in the existing literature. Specifically, we characterize the equilibrium of agent participation under two prominent mechanisms: the Shapley Value (SV) and Marginal Contribution (MC) mechanisms. Although SV is fair in surplus allocation and budget balanced, it has a vital pitfall: agents are incentivized to split their data across newly created fake identities. This is critical especially in the MCFL setting as it leads to slow convergence of FL optimization, which increases the number of required synchronization/communication rounds even when the per-round cost is fixed. In contrast, while MC is not budget-balanced, it is robust to such strategic manipulation and is able to induce an equilibrium that maximizes the MCFL system efficiency. Overall, our study lays a foundation for jointly designing incentives and algorithms in MCFL systems. We provide insights on pitfalls of SV: it induces a system equilibrium that leads to tremendous training cost and slower convergence, ultimately undermining the effectiveness of collaborative learning.

AI.title_translation: 协作式联邦学习的机制：Shapley值的陷阱
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个多动作协作式联邦学习（MCFL）框架，并分析了激励机制（特别是Shapley值和边际贡献机制）对模型收敛性和效率的影响。研究发现，Shapley值机制虽然公平，但会激励代理商进行数据欺诈，导致收敛速度变慢和训练成本增加；而边际贡献机制虽然不平衡预算，但能有效防止数据欺诈，提高系统效率。
AI.motivation: 现有研究忽略了激励设计与优化算法性能之间的直接联系，本研究旨在建立这种联系，并研究机制设计对协作式联邦学习系统的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一个多动作协作式联邦学习（MCFL）框架，并分析了两种激励机制：Shapley值（SV）和边际贡献（MC）机制。研究了这些机制如何影响代理商的参与均衡，进而影响联邦学习的收敛速度和计算效率。
AI.result: Shapley值机制虽然公平，但代理商可以通过创建虚假身份来分割数据，导致联邦学习收敛速度减慢，增加了同步/通信轮数。边际贡献机制虽然不平衡预算，但能防止此类策略性操纵，并诱导最大化MCFL系统效率的均衡。
AI.conclusion: Shapley值机制在协作式联邦学习中存在严重缺陷，会导致巨大的训练成本和收敛速度变慢，从而破坏协作学习的有效性。边际贡献机制是更优的选择，能够提高系统效率。
AI.translation: 本篇论文研究了机制设计对联邦学习（FL）赋能的协作学习系统的影响。我们提出了一个多动作协作式联邦学习（MCFL）框架，捕捉了代理商策略、平台机制和FL算法之间的相互作用——这是协作学习中的一个“三人问题”。这项工作证明了FL的收敛速度和计算效率是如何由机制所诱导的代理商参与均衡内生确定的。通过这样做，我们在协作学习系统中的激励设计与底层优化算法的性能之间建立了一个直接的联系，而这一联系在现有文献中在很大程度上被忽视了。具体来说，我们表征了在两种主要的机制下代理商参与的均衡：Shapley值（SV）和边际贡献（MC）机制。尽管SV在剩余分配和预算平衡方面是公平的，但它有一个关键的缺陷：代理商被激励将数据分割到新创建的虚假身份中。这一点在MCFL设置中尤为关键，因为它会导致FL优化收敛缓慢，即使在每轮成本固定的情况下，也会增加所需的同步/通信轮数。相比之下，尽管MC不平衡预算，但它能抵抗此类策略性操纵，并能诱导最大化MCFL系统效率的均衡。总的来说，我们的研究为MCFL系统中的联合激励和算法设计奠定了基础。我们对SV的缺陷提供了见解：它诱导了一个导致巨大训练成本和收敛速度变慢的系统均衡，最终破坏了协作学习的有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一个多动作协作式联邦学习（MCFL）框架，并分析了激励机制对系统性能的影响。研究发现，Shapley值机制虽然公平，但容易被代理商滥用，导致收敛速度减慢和训练成本增加。相比之下，边际贡献机制虽然不平衡预算，但能有效防止数据欺诈，提高系统整体效率。该研究为设计更优的激励与算法协同机制提供了理论基础。
AI.keywords: 协作式联邦学习, 激励机制, Shapley值, 边际贡献, 收敛速度
AI.comments: 该研究深入分析了激励机制在协作式联邦学习中的作用，并指出了Shapley值机制的一个关键缺陷，即容易被代理商利用来分割数据，从而影响模型收敛速度和训练成本。研究提出的MCFL框架和对边际贡献机制的分析，为设计更有效、更公平的联邦学习系统提供了有价值的见解。然而，研究可能需要进一步探讨在实际应用中如何有效实施边际贡献机制，以及如何应对其他潜在的策略性行为。

title: List Sample Compression and Uniform Convergence
summary:
List learning is a variant of supervised classification where the learner outputs multiple plausible labels for each instance rather than just one. We investigate classical principles related to generalization within the context of list learning. Our primary goal is to determine whether classical principles in the PAC setting retain their applicability in the domain of list PAC learning. We focus on uniform convergence (which is the basis of Empirical Risk Minimization) and on sample compression (which is a powerful manifestation of Occam's Razor). In classical PAC learning, both uniform convergence and sample compression satisfy a form of `completeness': whenever a class is learnable, it can also be learned by a learning rule that adheres to these principles. We ask whether the same completeness holds true in the list learning setting.
  We show that uniform convergence remains equivalent to learnability in the list PAC learning setting. In contrast, our findings reveal surprising results regarding sample compression: we prove that when the label space is $Y=\{0,1,2\}$, then there are 2-list-learnable classes that cannot be compressed. This refutes the list version of the sample compression conjecture by Littlestone and Warmuth (1986). We prove an even stronger impossibility result, showing that there are $2$-list-learnable classes that cannot be compressed even when the reconstructed function can work with lists of arbitrarily large size. We prove a similar result for (1-list) PAC learnable classes when the label space is unbounded. This generalizes a recent result by arXiv:2308.06424.

AI.title_translation: 列表样本压缩与一致收敛
AI.tldr: 在列表学习中，一致收敛等同于可学习性，但样本压缩并不总是成立，这与之前的猜想相悖。
AI.motivation: 研究在列表学习的背景下，PAC学习中的经典泛化原理（如一致收敛和样本压缩）是否仍然适用。
AI.method: 理论分析，证明了列表学习中一致收敛与可学习性的等价性，并证明了在特定条件下样本压缩失效。
AI.result: 证明了在列表PAC学习中，一致收敛等同于可学习性。然而，当标签空间为Y={0,1,2}时，存在无法压缩的2-列表可学习类，反驳了Littlestone和Warmuth的样本压缩猜想。即使允许任意大小的列表，也存在无法压缩的2-列表可学习类。对于标签空间无界的（1-列表）PAC可学习类也存在类似结果。
AI.conclusion: 一致收敛在列表学习中保持其重要性，而样本压缩的完备性原则在列表学习中并不成立，这表明列表学习在泛化方面存在与经典PAC学习不同的特性。
AI.translation:
列表学习是监督分类的一种变体，其中学习器为每个实例输出多个可能的标签，而不是只有一个。我们在列表学习的背景下研究与泛化相关的经典原理。我们的主要目标是确定PAC设置中的经典原理是否在列表PAC学习领域保持其适用性。我们关注一致收敛（这是经验风险最小化的基础）和样本压缩（这是奥卡姆剃刀的一个强大体现）。在经典的PAC学习中，一致收敛和样本压缩都满足一种“完备性”：只要一个类是可学习的，它也可以通过遵循这些原理的学习规则来学习。我们想知道同样的完备性是否在列表学习设置中成立。
我们证明了在列表PAC学习设置中，一致收敛仍然等同于可学习性。相比之下，我们的发现揭示了关于样本压缩的惊人结果：我们证明了，当标签空间为Y={0,1,2}时，存在2-列表可学习的类无法被压缩。这反驳了Littlestone和Warmuth（1986）提出的样本压缩猜想的列表版本。我们证明了一个更强的不可行性结果，表明存在2-列表可学习的类，即使在重建函数可以处理任意大小的列表时也无法被压缩。对于标签空间无界的（1-列表）PAC可学习类，我们也证明了一个类似的结果。这推广了arXiv:2308.06424的最新结果。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了列表学习中的泛化原理，特别是与PAC学习中的一致收敛和样本压缩相关的经典概念。研究表明，一致收敛在列表学习中仍然等同于可学习性。然而，与经典PAC学习不同，样本压缩在列表学习中并不总是成立。具体来说，当标签空间为Y={0,1,2}时，存在无法压缩的2-列表可学习类，这反驳了样本压缩猜想的列表版本。研究还提出了更强的不可行性结果，并推广了相关研究。
AI.keywords: 列表学习, 一致收敛, 样本压缩, PAC学习, 泛化理论
AI.comments: 这项工作对列表学习的理论基础做出了重要贡献，突出了其与经典PAC学习的关键区别。关于样本压缩的发现尤其令人惊讶，并为理解列表学习的复杂性提供了新的视角。未来的研究可以探索这些发现对实际列表学习算法的影响。

title: SPOT: Point Cloud Based Stereo Visual Place Recognition for Similar and Opposing Viewpoints
comments: Expanded version with added appendix. Published in ICRA 2024. Project page: https://umautobots.github.io/spot
summary: Recognizing places from an opposing viewpoint during a return trip is a common experience for human drivers. However, the analogous robotics capability, visual place recognition (VPR) with limited field of view cameras under 180 degree rotations, has proven to be challenging to achieve. To address this problem, this paper presents Same Place Opposing Trajectory (SPOT), a technique for opposing viewpoint VPR that relies exclusively on structure estimated through stereo visual odometry (VO). The method extends recent advances in lidar descriptors and utilizes a novel double (similar and opposing) distance matrix sequence matching method. We evaluate SPOT on a publicly available dataset with 6.7-7.6 km routes driven in similar and opposing directions under various lighting conditions. The proposed algorithm demonstrates remarkable improvement over the state-of-the-art, achieving up to 91.7% recall at 100% precision in opposing viewpoint cases, while requiring less storage than all baselines tested and running faster than all but one. Moreover, the proposed method assumes no a priori knowledge of whether the viewpoint is similar or opposing, and also demonstrates competitive performance in similar viewpoint cases.

title: Point-In-Context: Understanding Point Cloud via In-Context Learning
comments: Project page: https://fanglaosi.github.io/Point-In-Context_Pages. arXiv admin note: text overlap with arXiv:2306.08659
summary: The rise of large-scale models has catalyzed in-context learning as a powerful approach for multitasking, particularly in natural language and image processing. However, its application to 3D point cloud tasks has been largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce Point-In-Context (PIC), a pioneering framework for 3D point cloud understanding that leverages in-context learning with a standard transformer architecture. PIC uniquely enables the execution of multiple tasks after a single, unified training phase, eliminating the need for fine-tuning. To extend masked point modeling to 3D in-context learning, we introduce a Joint Sampling module, a simple yet effective technique that emphasizes the mapping relationship between input and target. PIC treats both inputs and targets as coordinate-based, addressing the segmentation challenge by associating label points with pre-defined XYZ coordinates for each category. However, relying on such fixed label-coordinate assignments limits the model's ability to generalize to unseen domains. To address this limitation, we further propose two innovative training strategies: In-Context Labeling and In-Context Enhancing. These strategies are integrated into PIC++, which enhances dynamic in-context labeling and model training. Besides its multitask capability, PIC++ demonstrates generalization across part segmentation datasets by employing dynamic in-context labels and regular in-context pairs. Remarkably, PIC++, trained once without fine-tuning, can generalize effectively to unseen datasets and perform novel part segmentation through customized prompts. Overall, PIC is a general framework that seamlessly integrates additional tasks or datasets through a unified data format via in-context learning. Extensive experiments substantiate PIC's versatility and adaptability in handling diverse tasks and segmenting multiple datasets simultaneously.

title: TF4CTR: Twin Focus Framework for CTR Prediction via Adaptive Sample Differentiation
summary: Effective feature interaction modeling is critical for enhancing the accuracy of click-through rate (CTR) prediction in industrial recommender systems. Most of the current deep CTR models resort to building complex network architectures to better capture intricate feature interactions or user behaviors. However, we identify two limitations in these models: (1) the samples given to the model are undifferentiated, which may lead the model to learn a larger number of easy samples in a single-minded manner while ignoring a smaller number of hard samples, thus reducing the model's generalization ability; (2) differentiated feature interaction encoders are designed to capture different interactions information but receive consistent supervision signals, thereby limiting the effectiveness of the encoder. To bridge the identified gaps, this paper introduces a novel CTR prediction framework by integrating the plug-and-play Twin Focus (TF) Loss, Sample Selection Embedding Module (SSEM), and Dynamic Fusion Module (DFM), named the Twin Focus Framework for CTR (TF4CTR). Specifically, the framework employs the SSEM at the bottom of the model to differentiate between samples, thereby assigning a more suitable encoder for each sample. Meanwhile, the TF Loss provides tailored supervision signals to both simple and complex encoders. Moreover, the DFM dynamically fuses the feature interaction information captured by the encoders, resulting in more accurate predictions. Experiments on five real-world datasets confirm the effectiveness and compatibility of the framework, demonstrating its capacity to enhance various representative baselines in a model-agnostic manner. To facilitate reproducible research, our open-sourced code and detailed running logs will be made available at: https://github.com/salmon1802/TF4CTR.

title: Accurate Quantization for Gait Representation Learning
summary: Existing deep learning methods have made significant progress in gait representation learning. Quantization can facilitate the application of gait models as a model-agnostic general compression technique. Typically, appearance-based models binarize inputs into silhouette sequences. However, mainstream quantization methods prioritize minimizing task loss over quantization error, which is detrimental to gait representation learning with binarized inputs. To address this, we propose a differentiable soft quantizer, which better simulates the gradient of the round function during backpropagation. This enables the network to learn from subtle input perturbations. However, our theoretical analysis and empirical studies reveal that directly applying the soft quantizer can hinder network convergence. We addressed this issue by adopting a two-stage training strategy, introducing a soft quantizer during the fine-tuning phase. However, in the first stage of training, we observed a significant change in the output distribution of different samples in the feature space compared to the full-precision network. It is this change that led to a loss in performance. Based on this, we propose an Inter-class Distance-guided Calibration (IDC) strategy to preserve the relative distance between the embeddings of samples with different labels. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach, demonstrating state-of-the-art accuracy across various settings and datasets.

title: Revisit, Extend, and Enhance Hessian-Free Influence Functions
summary: Influence functions serve as crucial tools for assessing sample influence in model interpretation, subset training set selection, noisy label detection, and more. By employing the first-order Taylor extension, influence functions can estimate sample influence without the need for expensive model retraining. However, applying influence functions directly to deep models presents challenges, primarily due to the non-convex nature of the loss function and the large size of model parameters. This difficulty not only makes computing the inverse of the Hessian matrix costly but also renders it non-existent in some cases. Various approaches, including matrix decomposition, have been explored to expedite and approximate the inversion of the Hessian matrix, with the aim of making influence functions applicable to deep models. In this paper, we revisit a specific, albeit naive, yet effective approximation method known as TracIn. This method substitutes the inverse of the Hessian matrix with an identity matrix. We provide deeper insights into why this simple approximation method performs well. Furthermore, we extend its applications beyond measuring model utility to include considerations of fairness and robustness. Finally, we enhance TracIn through an ensemble strategy. To validate its effectiveness, we conduct experiments on synthetic data and extensive evaluations on noisy label detection, sample selection for large language model fine-tuning, and defense against adversarial attacks.

title: Does Geo-co-location Matter? A Case Study of Public Health Conversations during COVID-19
summary: Social media platforms like Twitter (now X) have been pivotal in information dissemination and public engagement. The objective of our research is to analyze the effect of localized engagement on social media conversations. This study examines the impact of geographic co-location, as a proxy for localized engagement. Our research is grounded in a COVID-19 dataset. A key goal during the pandemic for public health experts was to encourage prosocial behavior that could impact local outcomes such as masking and social distancing. Given the importance of local news and guidance during COVID-19, we analyze the effect of localized engagement, between public health experts (PHEs) and the public, on social media. We analyze a Twitter Conversation dataset from January 2020 to November 2021, comprising over 19 K tweets from nearly five hundred PHEs, and 800 K replies from 350 K participants. We use a Poisson regression model to show that geo-co-location is indeed associated with higher engagement. Lexical features associated with emotion and personal experiences were more common in geo-co-located conversations. To complement our statistical analysis, we also applied a large language model (LLM)-based method to automatically generate and evaluate hypotheses; the LLM results confirm the results using lexical features. This research provides insights into how geographic co-location influences social media engagement and can inform strategies to improve public health messaging.

title: HPE-CogVLM: Advancing Vision Language Models with a Head Pose Grounding Task
comments: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT), 2026. This version includes major updates in methodology and experiments. The final version is available at IEEE Xplore
summary: Head pose estimation (HPE) requires a sophisticated understanding of 3D spatial relationships to generate precise yaw, pitch, and roll angles. Previous HPE models, primarily CNN-based, rely on cropped close-up human head images as inputs and often lack robustness in real-world scenario. Vision Language Models (VLMs) can analyze entire images while focusing on specific objects through their attention mechanisms. In this paper, we propose a novel framework to improve the HPE accuracy by leveraging the object detection grounding capability of a VLM, referred to as CogVLM. We empirically find that directly LoRA fine-tuning of this VLM for the HPE task fails to achieve desirable HPE accuracy, while some model merging methods can improve accuracy but frequently produce blended invalid response formats, struggling to handle both object detection and HPE tasks simultaneously. To integrate HPE capability into CogVLM effectively, we develop a novel LoRA layer-based model merging method. This merging approach applies a high cosine similarity threshold and a 'winner-takes-all' layer selection strategy, aligning attention to the HPE task while preserving original object detection knowledge. It successfully resolves issues with blended invalid response formats and improves accuracy. Results show that our HPE-CogVLM achieves a 31.5% reduction in Mean Absolute Error over the current state-of-the-art CNN model, 6DRepNet, in cross-dataset evaluation. Furthermore, HPE-CogVLM outperforms both directly LoRA fine-tuned and task arithmetic-based merged VLMs across all HPE metrics.

title: DifAttack++: Query-Efficient Black-Box Adversarial Attack via Hierarchical Disentangled Feature Space in Cross-Domain
comments: arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2309.14585 An extension of the AAAI24 paper "DifAttack: Query-Efficient Black-Box Attack via Disentangled Feature Space."
summary: This work investigates efficient score-based black-box adversarial attacks with a high Attack Success Rate (\textbf{ASR}) and good generalizability. We design a novel attack method based on a hierarchical DIsentangled Feature space, called \textbf{DifAttack++}, which differs significantly from the existing ones operating over the entire feature space. Specifically, DifAttack++ firstly disentangles an image's latent feature into an Adversarial Feature (\textbf{AF}) and a Visual Feature (\textbf{VF}) via an autoencoder equipped with our specially designed Hierarchical Decouple-Fusion (\textbf{HDF}) module, where the AF dominates the adversarial capability of an image, while the VF largely determines its visual appearance. We train such two autoencoders for the clean and adversarial image domains (i.e., cross-domain) respectively to achieve image reconstructions and feature disentanglement, by using pairs of clean images and their Adversarial Examples (\textbf{AE}s) generated from available surrogate models via white-box attack methods. Eventually, in the black-box attack stage, DifAttack++ iteratively optimizes the AF according to the query feedback from the victim model until a successful AE is generated, while keeping the VF unaltered. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our DifAttack++ leads to superior ASR and query efficiency than state-of-the-art methods, meanwhile exhibiting much better visual quality of AEs. The code is available at https://github.com/csjunjun/DifAttack.git.

title: Your Absorbing Discrete Diffusion Secretly Models the Conditional Distributions of Clean Data
summary: Discrete diffusion models with absorbing processes have shown promise in language modeling. The key quantities to be estimated are the ratios between the marginal probabilities of two transitive states at all timesteps, called the concrete score. In this paper, we reveal that the concrete score in absorbing diffusion can be expressed as conditional probabilities of clean data, multiplied by a time-dependent scalar in an analytic form. Motivated by this finding, we propose reparameterized absorbing discrete diffusion (RADD), a dedicated diffusion model without time-condition that characterizes the time-independent conditional probabilities. Besides its simplicity, RADD can reduce the number of function evaluations (NFEs) by caching the output of the time-independent network when the noisy sample remains unchanged in a sampling interval, which enables sampling acceleration. Built upon the new perspective of conditional distributions, we further unify absorbing discrete diffusion and any-order autoregressive models (AO-ARMs), showing that the upper bound on the negative log-likelihood for the diffusion model can be interpreted as an expected negative log-likelihood for AO-ARMs. Further, our RADD models achieve SOTA performance among diffusion models on 5 zero-shot language modeling benchmarks (measured by perplexity) at the GPT-2 scale. Our code is available at https://github.com/ML-GSAI/RADD.

AI.title_translation: 你的吸收离散扩散模型秘密地建模了干净数据的条件分布
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了吸收离散扩散模型中的具体分数实际上建模了干净数据的条件分布，并基于此提出了RADD模型。RADD模型更简单、更高效（减少NFE，加速采样），实现了扩散模型在零样本语言建模任务上的SOTA性能，并统一了吸收离散扩散与任意阶自回归模型。
AI.motivation: 本文旨在揭示吸收离散扩散模型中关键量“具体分数”的内在机制，证明其可以表示为干净数据的条件概率与一个时变标量之积。这一发现为开发更简单、更高效的扩散模型提供了理论基础。
AI.method: 1. 揭示吸收扩散模型中的具体分数可以解析地表达为干净数据的条件概率乘以一个时变标量。2. 提出重新参数化的吸收离散扩散模型（RADD），这是一个没有时间条件的专用扩散模型，用于表征时间无关的条件概率。3. RADD通过在采样间隔内噪声样本不变时缓存时间无关网络的输出来减少函数评估次数（NFEs），从而实现采样加速。4. 基于条件分布的新视角，统一了吸收离散扩散模型和任意阶自回归模型（AO-ARMs），表明扩散模型的负对数似然上界可以解释为AO-ARMs的预期负对数似然。
AI.result: 1. 吸收扩散模型中的具体分数可以解析地表达为干净数据的条件概率乘以一个时变标量。2. RADD模型能够减少函数评估次数（NFEs），并实现采样加速。3. RADD模型在5个GPT-2规模的零样本语言建模基准测试（以困惑度衡量）中，在扩散模型中取得了SOTA性能。4. 成功统一了吸收离散扩散模型和任意阶自回归模型（AO-ARMs）。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了吸收离散扩散模型的具体分数秘密地建模了干净数据的条件分布，并基于此提出了RADD模型。RADD模型不仅简化了扩散过程，提高了采样效率，还在语言建模任务上达到了最先进的性能，同时在理论上统一了吸收离散扩散与自回归模型。
AI.translation: 吸收过程的离散扩散模型在语言建模中显示出前景。需要估计的关键量是所有时间步长上两个瞬态边际概率之间的比率，称为具体分数。在本文中，我们揭示了吸收扩散中的具体分数可以解析地表示为干净数据的条件概率乘以一个时变标量。受此发现的启发，我们提出了重新参数化的吸收离散扩散（RADD），这是一种没有时间条件的专用扩散模型，用于表征时间无关的条件概率。除了其简洁性之外，当噪声样本在采样间隔内保持不变时，RADD可以通过缓存时间无关网络的输出来减少函数评估次数（NFEs），从而实现采样加速。基于条件分布的新视角，我们进一步统一了吸收离散扩散和任意阶自回归模型（AO-ARMs），表明扩散模型的负对数似然上界可以解释为AO-ARMs的预期负对数似然。此外，我们的RADD模型在5个GPT-2规模的零样本语言建模基准测试（以困惑度衡量）中，在扩散模型中取得了SOTA性能。我们的代码可在https://github.com/ML-GSAI/RADD获取。
AI.summary: 本文揭示了吸收离散扩散模型中的具体分数实际上建模了干净数据的条件分布，并基于此提出了一种名为RADD的重新参数化离散扩散模型。RADD模型无需时间条件，能高效地表征时间无关的条件概率，并通过缓存机制减少函数评估次数，从而加速采样。此外，该研究将吸收离散扩散与任意阶自回归模型进行了统一，并证明RADD模型在零样本语言建模基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 吸收离散扩散, 条件分布, 重新参数化扩散, 语言建模, AO-ARMs
AI.comments: 该论文通过揭示吸收离散扩散模型中具体分数与干净数据条件分布的内在联系，提供了重要的理论洞察。RADD模型的提出不仅简化了模型设计，还通过减少函数评估和加速采样显著提高了效率。在语言建模任务上取得SOTA性能，进一步验证了其在实践中的有效性。此外，将扩散模型与自回归模型统一，为理解和发展生成模型开辟了新的视角和理论基础，具有重要的创新性和影响力。

title: MSADM: Large Language Model (LLM) Assisted End-to-End Network Health Management Based on Multi-Scale Semanticization
summary: Network device and system health management is the foundation of modern network operations and maintenance. Traditional health management methods, relying on expert identification or simple rule-based algorithms, struggle to cope with the heterogeneous networks (HNs) environment. Moreover, current state-of-the-art distributed fault diagnosis methods, which utilize specific machine learning techniques, lack multi-scale adaptivity for heterogeneous device information, resulting in unsatisfactory diagnostic accuracy for HNs. In this paper, we develop an LLM-assisted end-to-end intelligent network health management framework. The framework first proposes a multi-scale data scaling method based on unsupervised learning to address the multi-scale data problem in HNs. Secondly, we combine the semantic rule tree with the attention mechanism to propose a Multi-Scale Semanticized Anomaly Detection Model (MSADM) that generates network semantic information while detecting anomalies. Finally, we embed a chain-of-thought-based large-scale language model downstream to adaptively analyze the fault diagnosis results and create an analysis report containing detailed fault information and optimization strategies. We compare our scheme with other fault diagnosis models and demonstrate that it performs well on several metrics of network fault diagnosis.

AI.title_translation: 基于多尺度语义化的LLM辅助端到端网络健康管理
AI.tldr: 针对异构网络健康管理中的多尺度适应性差的问题，本文开发了一个端到端的LLM辅助框架，通过多尺度数据缩放和MSADM模型（结合语义树和注意力机制）进行异常检测，最后用CoT-LLM生成故障分析报告，实验证明性能优越。
AI.motivation: 传统依赖专家识别或简单规则的方法难以应对异构网络（HNs）环境；现有的分布式故障诊断方法缺乏对异构设备信息的**多尺度适应性**，导致诊断准确性不理想。
AI.method: 首先，提出了一种基于无监督学习的多尺度数据缩放方法；其次，提出了结合语义规则树和注意力机制的多尺度语义化异常检测模型（MSADM）以生成网络语义信息并检测异常；最后，嵌入一个基于思维链（chain-of-thought）的大型语言模型来分析诊断结果并生成报告。
AI.result: 与其他故障诊断模型相比，该方案在多个网络故障诊断指标上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方案在多个网络故障诊断指标上表现良好。
AI.translation: 网络设备和系统的健康管理是现代网络运维的基础。依赖专家识别或简单规则算法的传统健康管理方法，难以应对异构网络（HN）环境。此外，当前利用特定机器学习技术的最先进的分布式故障诊断方法，缺乏对异构设备信息的**多尺度适应性**，导致对HNs的诊断准确性不令人满意。在本文中，我们开发了一个LLM辅助的端到端智能网络健康管理框架。该框架首先提出了一种基于无监督学习的多尺度数据缩放方法，以解决HNs中的多尺度数据问题。其次，我们结合语义规则树和注意力机制，提出了多尺度语义化异常检测模型（MSADM），该模型在检测异常的同时生成网络语义信息。最后，我们将一个基于思维链（chain-of-thought）的大型语言模型嵌入下游，以自适应地分析故障诊断结果，并创建包含详细故障信息和优化策略的分析报告。我们将我们的方案与其他故障诊断模型进行了比较，并证明了它在多个网络故障诊断指标上表现良好。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于大型语言模型（LLM）辅助的端到端智能网络健康管理框架，以解决异构网络中传统方法和现有机器学习方法在多尺度适应性方面的不足。该框架首先采用无监督学习进行多尺度数据缩放，然后利用结合语义规则树和注意力机制的MSADM模型进行语义化异常检测，最后通过基于思维链的LLM对诊断结果进行自适应分析并生成详细的故障报告和优化策略。
AI.keywords: 网络健康管理, 大型语言模型, 异构网络, 多尺度语义化, 异常检测
AI.comments: 该工作创新性地将大型语言模型（LLM）引入到端到端的网络健康管理中，并提出了多尺度语义化方法来处理异构网络中的多尺度数据问题，具有很强的实用价值。其局限性可能在于LLM的推理成本和最终诊断报告的准确性依赖于训练数据的质量。

title: Collaborative User Prompt for Personalized Generative Recommendation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become powerful foundations for generative recommender systems, framing recommendation tasks as text generation tasks. However, existing generative recommendation methods often rely on discrete ID-based prompts or task-specific soft prompts, which overlook the valuable collaborative signals shared among users with similar interests. To address this limitation, this paper presents a compositional framework that integrates a user's individual preferences with collective preferences from similar users to build personalized soft prompts. Specifically, an attention-based mechanism fuses embeddings from users with similar interests, creating a richer representation that captures multiple facets of user preferences. This design dynamically emphasizes shared interests while preserving individual user preferences. Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach across sequential recommendation, top-n recommendation, and explanation generation tasks, underscoring the advantages of incorporating collaborative signals through an attention-based compositional strategy.

AI.title_translation: 协同用户提示实现个性化生成式推荐
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种组合框架，通过注意力机制融合相似用户的集体偏好和个体偏好，以构建个性化软提示，从而改进生成式推荐系统。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式推荐方法常依赖于离散的基于ID的提示或任务特定的软提示，忽略了兴趣相似用户之间共享的宝贵协同信号。
AI.method: 本文提出一个组合框架，将用户的个体偏好与来自相似用户的集体偏好相结合，以构建个性化软提示。具体来说，采用基于注意力的机制融合兴趣相似用户的嵌入，创建更丰富的表征，捕捉用户偏好的多个方面，并动态强调共享兴趣，同时保留个体用户偏好。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，所提出的方法在序列推荐、top-n推荐和解释生成任务中均有效，强调了通过基于注意力的组合策略整合协同信号的优势。
AI.conclusion: 通过注意力机制整合协同信号的组合策略，能够有效提升生成式推荐系统的个性化和性能。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）已成为生成式推荐系统的强大基础，将推荐任务框定为文本生成任务。然而，现有的生成式推荐方法通常依赖于离散的基于ID的提示或任务特定的软提示，这忽略了兴趣相似用户之间共享的宝贵协同信号。为了解决这一限制，本文提出了一个组合框架，将用户的个体偏好与来自相似用户的集体偏好相结合，以构建个性化软提示。具体来说，一个基于注意力的机制融合了兴趣相似用户的嵌入，创建了一个更丰富的表征，捕捉了用户偏好的多个方面。这种设计动态地强调了共享兴趣，同时保留了个体用户偏好。在三个真实世界数据集上的实验证明了所提出的方法在序列推荐、top-n推荐和解释生成任务中的有效性，强调了通过基于注意力的组合策略整合协同信号的优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种创新的组合框架，旨在通过整合用户的个体偏好和来自相似用户的集体偏好来改进生成式推荐系统中的个性化软提示。该方法利用注意力机制融合用户嵌入，有效捕捉并平衡共享与个体用户兴趣，实验证明其在多种推荐任务中均表现出显著效果。
AI.keywords: 生成式推荐, 协同过滤, 用户提示, 大语言模型, 注意力机制
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将协同信号通过注意力机制融入到生成式推荐的提示构建中，有效解决了现有方法忽视用户间协同信息的问题，为个性化生成式推荐提供了新的思路。

title: RoboMorph: Evolving Robot Morphology using Large Language Models
summary: We introduce RoboMorph, an automated approach for generating and optimizing modular robot designs using large language models (LLMs) and evolutionary algorithms. Each robot design is represented by a structured grammar, and we use LLMs to efficiently explore this design space. Traditionally, such exploration is time-consuming and computationally intensive. Using a best-shot prompting strategy combined with reinforcement learning (RL)-based control evaluation, RoboMorph iteratively refines robot designs within an evolutionary feedback loop. Across four terrain types, RoboMorph discovers diverse, terrain-specialized morphologies, including wheeled quadrupeds and hexapods, that match or outperform designs produced by Robogrammar's graph-search method. These results demonstrate that LLMs, when coupled with evolutionary selection, can serve as effective generative operators for automated robot design. Our project page and code are available at https://robomorph.github.io.

AI.title_translation: RoboMorph：使用大型语言模型进化机器人形态
AI.tldr: RoboMorph结合大型语言模型和进化算法，自动化生成和优化模块化机器人设计，能高效发现适应不同地形的机器人形态，并超越传统方法。
AI.motivation: 传统的机器人设计空间探索耗时且计算密集，本研究旨在通过自动化方法提高效率。
AI.method: RoboMorph通过结构化语法表示机器人设计，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）结合最佳提示策略和基于强化学习（RL）的控制评估，在进化反馈循环中迭代优化机器人设计。
AI.result: RoboMorph在四种地形类型上发现了多样化、适应特定地形的形态，包括轮式四足机器人和六足机器人，其性能匹配或超越了Robogrammar的图搜索方法。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型与进化选择相结合，可以作为自动化机器人设计的有效生成算子。
AI.translation: 我们引入了RoboMorph，这是一种利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和进化算法生成和优化模块化机器人设计的自动化方法。每个机器人设计都由结构化语法表示，我们使用LLMs高效探索这个设计空间。传统上，这种探索是耗时且计算密集的。RoboMorph采用最佳提示策略结合基于强化学习（RL）的控制评估，在进化反馈循环中迭代完善机器人设计。在四种地形类型上，RoboMorph发现了多样化、适应特定地形的形态，包括轮式四足机器人和六足机器人，其性能匹配或超越了Robogrammar的图搜索方法。这些结果表明，LLMs与进化选择相结合时，可以作为自动化机器人设计的有效生成算子。我们的项目页面和代码可在https://robomorph.github.io获取。
AI.summary: RoboMorph提出了一种自动化方法，利用大型语言模型（LLMs）和进化算法，高效生成和优化模块化机器人设计。该方法通过结构化语法表示机器人，并结合最佳提示策略与强化学习进行迭代优化。实验结果表明，RoboMorph能在多种地形上发现多样化且性能优异的机器人形态，证明了LLMs在自动化机器人设计中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 机器人形态, 大型语言模型, 进化算法, 自动化设计, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将大型语言模型与进化算法相结合，用于机器人形态的自动化设计和优化，有效解决了传统方法中设计空间探索耗时且计算密集的问题。这种结合为机器人设计领域提供了一种高效且强大的新范式。

title: Cognitive Spillover in Human-AI Teams
summary: AI is not only a neutral tool in team settings; it influence the social and cognitive fabric of collaboration. Across two randomized experiments, we demonstrate that AI exposure produces causal spillover into human-human interaction -- affecting shared language, collective attention, shared mental models, and social cohesion. These spillover effects occur robustly across settings, modalities, tasks, and AI qualities, suggesting that mere exposure to AI drives the influence. AI functions as an implicit ``social forcefield,'' influencing not only how people speak, but also how they think, what they attend to, and how they relate to each other. We argue for shifting the design paradigm from optimizing ``AI as a tool'' to understanding AI as a socially influential actor whose effects extend beyond the human-AI interface.

AI.title_translation: 人机团队中的认知溢出效应
AI.tldr: AI在团队中不仅是中立工具，它会通过认知溢出效应影响人际互动中的共享语言、集体注意力、共享心智模型和社会凝聚力。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为AI在团队中是中立工具，但本研究认为AI会影响协作的社会和认知结构，因此旨在通过实验证明AI对人际互动的因果溢出效应。
AI.method: 通过两项随机实验来证明AI暴露对人际互动产生因果溢出效应。
AI.result: 研究发现，AI暴露会对人际互动产生因果溢出效应，影响共享语言、集体注意力、共享心智模型和社会凝聚力。这些溢出效应在不同设置、模式、任务和AI质量下均稳健存在，表明仅仅接触AI就会产生这种影响。AI被视为一个隐性的“社会力场”。
AI.conclusion: AI不仅仅是一个工具，而是一个具有社会影响力的参与者，其影响超越了人机界面。因此，设计范式应从优化“AI作为工具”转向理解AI作为一个社会影响力参与者。
AI.translation: 人工智能在团队环境中不仅仅是一个中立的工具；它会影响协作的社会和认知结构。通过两项随机实验，我们证明了接触人工智能会对人际互动产生因果溢出效应——影响共享语言、集体注意力、共享心智模型和社会凝聚力。这些溢出效应在不同设置、模式、任务和人工智能质量下都稳健发生，这表明仅仅接触人工智能就会产生这种影响。人工智能作为一个隐性的“社会力场”发挥作用，不仅影响人们的说话方式，还影响他们的思维方式、关注点以及彼此之间的关系。我们主张将设计范式从优化“人工智能作为工具”转变为理解人工智能作为一个具有社会影响力的参与者，其影响超越了人机界面。
AI.summary: 本研究通过两项随机实验证明，在人机团队中，AI不仅仅是一个中立工具，它会对人际互动产生显著的认知溢出效应，影响共享语言、集体注意力、共享心智模型和社会凝聚力。这些效应在多种条件下均稳健存在，表明AI充当了一个隐性的“社会力场”。研究呼吁将AI设计范式从工具视角转向理解AI作为具有社会影响力的参与者。
AI.keywords: 人机团队, 认知溢出, AI影响, 社会凝聚力, 共享心智模型
AI.comments: 这项研究创新性地指出AI在团队中的作用远超工具层面，强调了其作为“社会力场”的隐性影响力，对于理解人机协作的深层机制和未来AI系统设计具有重要意义。它拓宽了对AI影响的认知边界。

title: Finite Neural Networks as Mixtures of Gaussian Processes: From Provable Error Bounds to Prior Selection
summary: Infinitely wide or deep neural networks (NNs) with independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) parameters have been shown to be equivalent to Gaussian processes. Because of the favorable properties of Gaussian processes, this equivalence is commonly employed to analyze neural networks and has led to various breakthroughs over the years. However, neural networks and Gaussian processes are equivalent only in the limit; in the finite case there are currently no methods available to approximate a trained neural network with a Gaussian model with bounds on the approximation error. In this work, we present an algorithmic framework to approximate a neural network of finite width and depth, and with not necessarily i.i.d. parameters, with a mixture of Gaussian processes with error bounds on the approximation error. In particular, we consider the Wasserstein distance to quantify the closeness between probabilistic models and, by relying on tools from optimal transport and Gaussian processes, we iteratively approximate the output distribution of each layer of the neural network as a mixture of Gaussian processes. Crucially, for any NN and $ε>0$ our approach is able to return a mixture of Gaussian processes that is $ε$-close to the NN at a finite set of input points. Furthermore, we rely on the differentiability of the resulting error bound to show how our approach can be employed to tune the parameters of a NN to mimic the functional behavior of a given Gaussian process, e.g., for prior selection in the context of Bayesian inference. We empirically investigate the effectiveness of our results on both regression and classification problems with various neural network architectures. Our experiments highlight how our results can represent an important step towards understanding neural network predictions and formally quantifying their uncertainty.

AI.title_translation: 有限神经网络作为高斯过程的混合：从可证明的误差界到先验选择
AI.tldr: 本文提出一种算法框架，将有限宽深度的神经网络近似为高斯过程混合模型，并提供可证明的误差界，可用于理解预测和量化不确定性。
AI.motivation: 无限宽深度的神经网络与高斯过程等价，但这仅限于极限情况。对于有限神经网络，目前缺乏在近似误差界限下用高斯模型近似训练好的神经网络的方法。
AI.method: 本文提出一个算法框架，使用 Wasserstein 距离量化概率模型之间的接近度，并结合最优传输和高斯过程工具，迭代地将神经网络每一层的输出分布近似为高斯过程的混合。该方法能够在有限输入点集上为任何神经网络返回一个 ε-接近的混合高斯过程。此外，利用所得误差界的可微分性，该方法可用于调整神经网络参数以模仿给定高斯过程的功能行为，例如在贝叶斯推断中的先验选择。
AI.result: 该方法能够在有限输入点集上为任何神经网络返回一个 ε-接近的混合高斯过程。通过利用误差界的可微分性，可以调整神经网络参数以模仿给定高斯过程的功能行为，例如用于贝叶斯推断中的先验选择。在回归和分类问题上对各种神经网络架构进行了实证研究，结果突出了该方法在理解神经网络预测和形式化量化其不确定性方面的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究结果代表了理解神经网络预测和形式化量化其不确定性的重要一步。
AI.translation: 无限宽或深的具有独立同分布（i.i.d.）参数的神经网络（NNs）已被证明等价于高斯过程。由于高斯过程的良好特性，这种等价性常被用于分析神经网络，并在过去几年中带来了各种突破。然而，神经网络和高斯过程仅在极限情况下等价；在有限情况下，目前尚无方法在近似误差界限下用高斯模型近似训练好的神经网络。在这项工作中，我们提出一个算法框架，用于近似有限宽度和深度、参数不一定是独立同分布的神经网络，使用高斯过程的混合模型，并提供近似误差的误差界。具体而言，我们考虑 Wasserstein 距离来量化概率模型之间的接近度，并通过依赖最优传输和高斯过程的工具，我们迭代地将神经网络每一层的输出分布近似为高斯过程的混合。至关重要的是，对于任何神经网络和 ε>0，我们的方法能够在有限的输入点集上返回一个与神经网络 ε-接近的高斯过程混合模型。此外，我们利用所得误差界的可微分性来展示我们的方法如何用于调整神经网络的参数，以模仿给定高斯过程的功能行为，例如在贝叶斯推断背景下的先验选择。我们通过回归和分类问题以及各种神经网络架构实证研究了我们结果的有效性。我们的实验强调了我们的结果如何代表理解神经网络预测和形式化量化其不确定性 an important step towards understanding neural network predictions and formally quantifying their uncertainty。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的算法框架，旨在解决有限宽度和深度神经网络与高斯过程之间近似的挑战。不同于无限神经网络与高斯过程的极限等价性，该框架利用 Wasserstein 距离、最优传输和高斯过程混合模型，迭代地近似有限神经网络的输出分布，并提供可证明的近似误差界。该方法能够在有限输入点集上生成一个 ε-接近的混合高斯过程，并且可以利用误差界的可微分性来调整神经网络参数，以模仿特定高斯过程的行为，例如在贝叶斯推断中进行先验选择。实验结果表明，该方法对于理解神经网络预测和量化不确定性具有重要意义。
AI.keywords: 有限神经网络, 高斯过程混合, 误差界, Wasserstein 距离, 先验选择
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于为有限神经网络与高斯过程之间的近似提供了一个具有可证明误差界的算法框架，弥补了现有理论主要集中在无限宽度/深度神经网络的空白。通过引入 Wasserstein 距离和最优传输，它提供了一种量化和控制近似误差的严谨方法，这对于神经网络的理论分析和实际应用（如不确定性量化和贝叶斯先验选择）都具有重要意义。

title: Parameterized Verification of Systems with Precise (0,1)-Counter Abstraction
comments: Newest version updates grant information in the acknowledgements (wrong grant number was used for GSP&Co.)
summary: We introduce a new framework for verifying systems with a parametric number of concurrently running processes. The systems we consider are well-structured with respect to a specific well-quasi order. This allows us to decide a wide range of verification problems, including control-state reachability, coverability, and target, in a fixed finite abstraction of the infinite state-space, called a 01-counter system. We show that several systems from the parameterized verification literature fall into this class, including reconfigurable broadcast networks (or systems with lossy broadcast), disjunctive systems, synchronizations and systems with a fixed number of shared finite-domain variables. Our framework provides a simple and unified explanation for the properties of these systems, which have so far been investigated separately. Additionally, it extends and improves on a range of the existing results, and gives rise to other systems with similar properties.

AI.title_translation: 具有精确(0,1)计数器抽象的系统参数化验证
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种新的框架，用于验证具有参数化并发进程数量的系统，通过01-计数器系统抽象，统一地解决了一系列参数化验证问题，并改进了现有结果。
AI.motivation: 验证具有参数化并发进程数量的系统，并为之前独立研究的各类系统提供一个统一的解释框架。
AI.method: 引入了一个新的框架，该框架将系统（对特定良拟序具有良好结构）抽象为01-计数器系统，这是一个有限的、无限状态空间的抽象，从而解决了一系列验证问题。
AI.result: 证明了参数化验证文献中的多种系统（如可重构广播网络、分离系统、同步和具有固定数量共享有限域变量的系统）属于该框架的类别。该框架扩展并改进了现有结果，并揭示了其他具有类似属性的系统。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为现有系统的属性提供了一个简单而统一的解释，并扩展和改进了现有结果，为其他具有类似属性的系统提供了基础。
AI.translation: 我们引入了一个新的框架，用于验证具有参数化数量并发运行进程的系统。我们考虑的系统在特定的良拟序方面具有良好结构。这使我们能够在一个称为01-计数器系统的无限状态空间的固定有限抽象中，决定广泛的验证问题，包括控制状态可达性、覆盖性和目标。我们展示了参数化验证文献中的多个系统属于此类，包括可重构广播网络（或具有有损广播的系统）、分离系统、同步以及具有固定数量共享有限域变量的系统。我们的框架为这些系统（迄今为止一直独立研究）的属性提供了一个简单而统一的解释。此外，它扩展并改进了一系列现有结果，并产生了其他具有类似属性的系统。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个新颖的框架，用于参数化验证具有并发进程的系统。该框架利用01-计数器系统作为对无限状态空间的固定有限抽象，能够解决控制状态可达性、覆盖性等多种验证问题。研究表明，许多现有参数化验证系统（如可重构广播网络、分离系统等）都可归入此框架，从而提供了一个统一的解释，并对现有成果进行了扩展和改进。
AI.keywords: 参数化验证, 01-计数器抽象, 并发系统, 良拟序, 形式化验证
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的框架和01-计数器抽象方法，能够处理多种参数化验证问题，并为之前独立研究的系统提供了整合的视角。其重要性在于简化了复杂系统的验证过程，并可能为未来相关研究奠定基础。

title: On the parameterized complexity of computing good edge-labelings
summary: A good edge-labeling (gel for short) of a graph $G$ is a function $λ: E(G) \to \mathbb{R}$ such that, for any ordered pair of vertices $(x, y)$ of $G$, there do not exist two distinct increasing paths from $x$ to $y$, where ``increasing'' means that the sequence of labels is non-decreasing. This notion was introduced by Bermond et al. [Theor. Comput. Sci. 2013] motivated by practical applications arising from routing and wavelength assignment problems in optical networks. Prompted by the lack of algorithmic results about the problem of deciding whether an input graph admits a gel, called GEL, we initiate its study from the viewpoint of parameterized complexity. We first introduce the natural version of GEL where one wants to use at most $c$ distinct labels, which we call $c$-GEL, and we prove that it is NP-complete for every $c \geq 2$ on very restricted instances. We then provide several positive results, starting with simple polynomial kernels for GEL and $c$-\GEL parameterized by neighborhood diversity or vertex cover. As one of our main technical contributions, we present an FPT algorithm for GEL parameterized by the size of a modulator to a forest of stars, based on a novel approach via a 2-SAT formulation which we believe to be of independent interest. We also present FPT algorithms based on dynamic programming for $c$-GEL parameterized by treewidth and $c$, and for GEL parameterized by treewidth and the maximum degree. Finally, we answer positively a question of Bermond et al. [Theor. Comput. Sci. 2013] by proving the NP-completeness of a problem strongly related to GEL, namely that of deciding whether an input graph admits a so-called UPP-orientation.

AI.title_translation: 关于计算良好边标注的参数化复杂性
AI.tldr: 本文从参数化复杂性的角度研究了图的良好边标注（GEL）问题，证明了c-GEL的NP完全性，并为GEL和c-GEL在不同参数下提供了多项式核和FPT算法，同时解决了与GEL相关的一个问题。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏关于判断输入图是否允许良好边标注（GEL）的算法结果，而GEL概念源于光网络中路由和波长分配的实际应用需求。
AI.method: 本文采用参数化复杂性理论进行研究。具体方法包括：证明c-GEL（使用至多c个不同标签的GEL）在受限实例上对c≥2是NP完全的；为GEL和c-GEL在邻域多样性或顶点覆盖参数下提供多项式核；基于2-SAT公式提出一种针对GEL在到星森林的调制器大小参数下的FPT算法；基于动态规划为c-GEL在树宽和c参数下以及GEL在树宽和最大度参数下提供FPT算法；证明了与GEL密切相关的UPP-orientation问题的NP完全性。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：对于任意c≥2，c-GEL在非常受限的实例上是NP完全的；为GEL和c-GEL在邻域多样性或顶点覆盖参数下提供了简单的多项式核；为GEL在到星森林的调制器大小参数下提供了一个FPT算法；为c-GEL在树宽和c参数下以及GEL在树宽和最大度参数下提供了FPT算法；证明了UPP-orientation问题的NP完全性，从而正面回答了Bermond等人提出的一个问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文从参数化复杂性角度对良好边标注问题（GEL）进行了初步研究，证明了c-GEL的NP完全性，并在多种参数下为GEL和c-GEL设计了有效的FPT算法和多项式核。此外，还通过证明UPP-orientation问题的NP完全性，回答了相关开放问题。
AI.translation: 图G的良好边标注（简称gel）是一个函数λ: E(G) → R，使得对于G的任何有序顶点对(x, y)，不存在两条不同的从x到y的递增路径，其中“递增”意味着标签序列是非递减的。这个概念由Bermond等人[Theor. Comput. Sci. 2013]提出，其动机是光网络中路由和波长分配问题产生的实际应用。由于缺乏关于判断输入图是否允许gel（称为GEL）的算法结果，我们从参数化复杂性的角度启动了对其的研究。我们首先引入了GEL的自然版本，即希望使用至多c个不同标签，我们称之为c-GEL，并证明了对于任何c≥2，它在非常受限的实例上是NP完全的。然后，我们提供了几个积极的结果，首先是为GEL和c-GEL在邻域多样性或顶点覆盖参数下提供了简单的多项式核。作为我们主要的技??贡献之一，我们基于一种我们认为具有独立兴趣的新颖的2-SAT公式方法，提出了一种针对GEL在到星森林的调制器大小参数下的FPT算法。我们还提出了基于动态规划的FPT算法，用于c-GEL在树宽和c参数下，以及GEL在树宽和最大度参数下。最后，我们通过证明一个与GEL密切相关的问题，即判断输入图是否允许所谓的UPP-orientation的NP完全性，正面回答了Bermond等人[Theor. Comput. Sci. 2013]提出的一个问题。
AI.summary: 本文从参数化复杂性的角度对图的良好边标注（GEL）问题进行了系统性研究。首先证明了使用至多c个不同标签的c-GEL问题在c≥2时是NP完全的。随后，为GEL和c-GEL在邻域多样性或顶点覆盖参数下给出了多项式核。作为核心贡献，提出了一种基于2-SAT公式的FPT算法，解决了GEL在到星森林的调制器大小参数下的问题。此外，还为c-GEL在树宽和c参数下以及GEL在树宽和最大度参数下设计了动态规划FPT算法。最后，通过证明UPP-orientation问题的NP完全性，回答了一个开放问题。
AI.keywords: 良好边标注, 参数化复杂性, FPT算法, NP完全性, 2-SAT公式
AI.comments: 本文在图论和算法领域具有重要意义。其创新之处在于首次将参数化复杂性应用于良好边标注问题，并提出了一种新颖的基于2-SAT公式的FPT算法，该方法本身可能具有更广泛的应用价值。研究结果为GEL问题的计算复杂性提供了深入理解，并为不同图结构和参数下的求解提供了高效算法。

title: Conditional Encryption with Applications to Secure Personalized Password Typo Correction
comments: Full version of CCS 2024 paper with the same title
summary: We introduce the notion of a conditional encryption scheme as an extension of public key encryption. In addition to the standard public key algorithms ($\mathsf{KG}$, $\mathsf{Enc}$, $\mathsf{Dec}$) for key generation, encryption and decryption, a conditional encryption scheme for a binary predicate $P$ adds a new conditional encryption algorithm $\mathsf{CEnc}$. The conditional encryption algorithm $c=\mathsf{CEnc}_{pk}(c_1,m_2,m_3)$ takes as input the public encryption key $pk$, a ciphertext $c_1 = \mathsf{Enc}_{pk}(m_1)$ for an unknown message $m_1$, a control message $m_2$ and a payload message $m_3$ and outputs a conditional ciphertext $c$. Intuitively, if $P(m_1,m_2)=1$ then the conditional ciphertext $c$ should decrypt to the payload message $m_3$. On the other hand if $P(m_1,m_2) = 0$ then the ciphertext should not leak any information about the control message $m_2$ or the payload message $m_3$ even if the attacker already has the secret decryption key $sk$. We formalize the notion of conditional encryption secrecy and provide concretely efficient constructions for a set of predicates relevant to password typo correction. Our practical constructions utilize the Paillier partially homomorphic encryption scheme as well as Shamir Secret Sharing. We prove that our constructions are secure and demonstrate how to use conditional encryption to improve the security of personalized password typo correction systems such as TypTop. We implement a C++ library for our practically efficient conditional encryption schemes and evaluate the performance empirically. We also update the implementation of TypTop to utilize conditional encryption for enhanced security guarantees and evaluate the performance of the updated implementation.
comment: Full version of CCS 2024 paper with the same title

AI.title_translation: 带条件的加密及其在安全个性化密码拼写纠正中的应用
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种条件加密方案，它扩展了公钥加密，允许在满足特定条件时解密特定信息，并将其应用于改进密码拼写纠正系统的安全性。
AI.motivation: 为了提高密码拼写纠正系统的安全性，特别是当用户输入错误时，需要一种能够在满足特定条件时泄露信息，否则不泄露任何信息的加密方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种条件加密方案，增加了条件加密算法 CEnc，该算法可以根据秘密信息 m1 和控制信息 m2 是否满足谓词 P 来决定是否解密载荷信息 m3。方案利用 Paillier 同态加密和 Shamir 秘密共享技术进行具体构造，并证明了其安全性。
AI.result: 实现了条件加密方案的 C++ 库，并进行了性能评估。更新了 TypTop 系统的实现以利用条件加密，并评估了更新后的系统性能，证明了该方案可以提高系统安全性。
AI.conclusion: 条件加密是一种有用的密码学工具，可以安全地实现个性化密码拼写纠正等应用，并提供了具体高效的构造和安全证明。
AI.translation: 我们引入了条件加密方案的概念，作为公钥加密的扩展。除了标准的密钥生成、加密和解密公钥算法（$\	ext{KG}$, $\	ext{Enc}$, $\	ext{Dec}$）之外，针对二元谓词 $P$ 的条件加密方案增加了一个新的条件加密算法 $\	ext{CEnc}$。条件加密算法 $c=\	ext{CEnc}_{pk}(c_1,m_2,m_3)$ 以公钥加密密钥 $pk$、未知消息 $m_1$ 的密文 $c_1 = \	ext{Enc}_{pk}(m_1)$、控制消息 $m_2$ 和载荷消息 $m_3$ 作为输入，并输出一个条件密文 $c$。直观地说，如果 $P(m_1,m_2)=1$，则条件密文 $c$ 应该解密为载荷消息 $m_3$。另一方面，如果 $P(m_1,m_2) = 0$，则即使攻击者已经拥有秘密解密密钥 $sk$，密文也不应泄露关于控制消息 $m_2$ 或载荷消息 $m_3$ 的任何信息。我们形式化了条件加密安全性的概念，并为与密码拼写纠正相关的谓词集提供了具体高效的构造。我们的实际构造利用了 Paillier 部分同态加密方案以及 Shamir 秘密共享。我们证明了我们的构造是安全的，并演示了如何使用条件加密来提高像 TypTop 这样的个性化密码拼写纠正系统的安全性。我们实现了我们实际高效的条件加密方案的 C++ 库，并进行了经验性能评估。我们还更新了 TypTop 实现，以利用条件加密来增强安全性保证，并评估了更新后实现的性能。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了条件加密（Conditional Encryption, CE）方案，作为对公钥加密的扩展。CE 方案通过引入一个条件加密算法 CEnc，允许在满足特定谓词 P 的条件下，将一个密文（包含秘密信息 m1）与控制信息 m2 和载荷信息 m3 结合，生成条件密文 c。若 P(m1, m2) = 1，则 c 解密为 m3；否则，即使拥有私钥，c 也不会泄露 m2 或 m3 的信息。研究人员使用 Paillier 同态加密和 Shamir 秘密共享技术进行了具体构造，并证明了其安全性。该方案可用于提升如 TypTop 等个性化密码拼写纠正系统的安全性。研究中实现了 C++ 库并进行了性能评估，同时更新了 TypTop 系统以应用 CE，并验证了其安全性提升和性能表现。
AI.keywords: 条件加密, 公钥加密, 密码拼写纠正, Paillier 同态加密, Shamir 秘密共享
AI.comments: 该研究提出的条件加密方案在理论和实践上都具有重要意义，特别是在保护用户隐私和提高系统安全性方面。将该方案应用于密码拼写纠正是其主要贡献之一，展示了其在实际场景中的应用价值。然而，对于大规模部署，其性能和可扩展性仍需进一步关注。

title: Edu-Values: Towards Evaluating the Chinese Education Values of Large Language Models
comments: The authors are withdrawing this paper to make substantial revisions and improvements before future submission
summary: In this paper, we present Edu-Values, the first Chinese education values evaluation benchmark that includes seven core values: professional philosophy, teachers' professional ethics, education laws and regulations, cultural literacy, educational knowledge and skills, basic competencies and subject knowledge. We meticulously design 1,418 questions, covering multiple-choice, multi-modal question answering, subjective analysis, adversarial prompts, and Chinese traditional culture (short answer) questions. We conduct human feedback based automatic evaluation over 21 state-of-the-art (SoTA) LLMs, and highlight three main findings: (1) due to differences in educational culture, Chinese LLMs outperform English LLMs, with Qwen 2 ranking the first with a score of 81.37; (2) LLMs often struggle with teachers' professional ethics and professional philosophy; (3) leveraging Edu-Values to build an external knowledge repository for RAG significantly improves LLMs' alignment. This demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed benchmark.

AI.title_translation: Edu-Values：旨在评估大型语言模型的中国教育价值观
AI.tldr: 提出了Edu-Values，一个评估大型语言模型中国教育价值观的基准，发现中文LLM表现优于英文LLM，且RAG能提升对齐。
AI.motivation: 评估和理解大型语言模型在处理中国教育价值观方面的能力，并识别其局限性。
AI.method: 提出了Edu-Values，首个包含七个核心中国教育价值观的评估基准，设计了1,418个问题，涵盖多种题型。对21个最先进（SoTA）的大型语言模型进行了基于人工反馈的自动评估。
AI.result: 主要发现包括：(1) 由于教育文化差异，中文大型语言模型表现优于英文大型语言模型，其中Qwen 2以81.37分位居第一；(2) 大型语言模型在教师职业道德和专业理念方面常常表现不佳；(3) 利用Edu-Values构建RAG的外部知识库显著提高了大型语言模型的对齐度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的Edu-Values基准是有效的，并揭示了大型语言模型在中国教育价值观方面的表现及其改进潜力。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们提出了Edu-Values，这是第一个评估大型语言模型中国教育价值观的基准，包含七个核心价值观：专业理念、教师职业道德、教育法律法规、文化素养、教育知识与技能、基本能力和学科知识。我们精心设计了1,418个问题，涵盖选择题、多模态问答、主观分析、对抗性提示以及中国传统文化（简答题）。我们对21个最先进（SoTA）的大型语言模型进行了基于人工反馈的自动评估，并强调了三个主要发现：(1) 由于教育文化差异，中文大型语言模型表现优于英文大型语言模型，其中Qwen 2以81.37分位居第一；(2) 大型语言模型在教师职业道德和专业理念方面常常表现不佳；(3) 利用Edu-Values构建RAG的外部知识库显著提高了大型语言模型的对齐度。这证明了所提出基准的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了Edu-Values，一个旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）中国教育价值观的首个基准。该基准涵盖专业理念、教师职业道德等七个核心价值观，并设计了1,418道多类型题目。通过对21个LLM进行评估，研究发现中文LLM在教育文化差异下表现更优，但LLM在特定伦理和理念方面存在不足。此外，利用Edu-Values构建RAG知识库能有效提升LLM的对齐能力，证明了该基准的有效性。
AI.keywords: 中国教育价值观, 大型语言模型, 评估基准, Edu-Values, RAG
AI.comments: 这项研究提出了一个新颖的、专注于中国教育价值观的评估基准，填补了现有LLM评估工具的空白。其多样的题型设计和对RAG改进潜力的揭示，为提升LLM在特定文化领域的能力提供了重要方向，对于推动LLM更好地服务于特定文化背景下的教育应用具有重要意义。

title: Split-or-decompose: Improved FPT branching algorithms for maximum agreement forests
comments: Accepted for journal publication. Compared to first arxiv version contains extra figures and clarifying paragraphs
summary: Phylogenetic trees are leaf-labelled trees used to model the evolution of species. In practice it is not uncommon to obtain two topologically distinct trees for the same set of species, and this motivates the use of distance measures to quantify dissimilarity. A well-known measure is the maximum agreement forest (MAF): a minimum-size partition of the leaf labels which splits both trees into the same set of disjoint, leaf-labelled subtrees (up to isomorphism after suppressing degree-2 vertices). Computing such a MAF is NP-hard and so considerable effort has been invested in finding FPT algorithms, parameterised by $k$, the number of components of a MAF. The state of the art has been unchanged since 2015, with running times of $O^*(3^k)$ for unrooted trees and $O^*(2.3431^k)$ for rooted trees. In this work we present improved algorithms for both the unrooted and rooted cases, with runtimes $O^*(2.846^k)$ and $O^*(2.3391^k)$ respectively. The key to our improvement is a novel branching strategy in which we show that any overlapping components obtained on the way to a MAF can be `split' by a branching rule with favourable branching factor, and then the problem can be decomposed into disjoint subproblems to be solved separately. We expect that this technique may be more widely applicable to other problems in algorithmic phylogenetics.
