AI.title_translation: 分裂或分解：改进的FPT最大一致森林算法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的分支策略，用于计算最大一致森林（MAF），将未加根树的运行时间从O(3^k)提高到O(2.846^k)，将加根树的运行时间从O(2.3431^k)提高到O(2.3391^k)。
AI.motivation: 在实践中，对于同一组物种，可能存在两个拓扑结构不同的进化树，需要计算最大一致森林（MAF）来量化其差异性。计算MAF是一个NP难问题，因此需要高效的FPT算法。
AI.method: 提出了一种新的分支策略，通过‘分裂’重叠分量并将问题分解为独立的子问题来解决。
AI.result: 未加根树的运行时间从O(3^k)提高到O(2.846^k)，加根树的运行时间从O(2.3431^k)提高到O(2.3391^k)。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的分裂或分解方法能够改进最大一致森林的FPT算法，并且该技术可能在算法系统发育学中得到更广泛的应用。
AI.translation: 进化树是用于模拟物种进化、带有叶子标签的树。在实践中，对于同一组物种获得两个拓扑上不同的树并不罕见，这促使人们使用距离度量来量化差异性。一个众所周知的度量是最大一致森林（MAF）：叶子标签的最小划分，它将两棵树分成同一组不相交的、叶子标签的子树（在抑制度为2的顶点后同构）。计算这样的MAF是NP难问题，因此在寻找FPT算法方面付出了巨大的努力，参数化为MAF分量的数量k。最新技术自2015年以来一直没有改变，未加根树的运行时间为O^*(3^k)，加根树的运行时间为O^*(2.3431^k)。在这项工作中，我们提出了改进的未加根树和加根树的算法，运行时间分别为O^*(2.846^k)和O^*(2.3391^k)。我们改进的关键在于一种新颖的分支策略，在该策略中，我们表明，在获得MAF的过程中获得的任何重叠分量都可以通过具有有利分支因子的分支规则进行‘分裂’，然后可以将问题分解为独立的子问题分别求解。我们预计这项技术可能更广泛地应用于算法系统发育学中的其他问题。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为“分裂或分解”的新型分支策略，用于改进最大一致森林（MAF）的固定参数可处理（FPT）算法。该方法通过将重叠分量“分裂”并分解为独立的子问题，成功降低了计算MAF的复杂度。具体而言，未加根树的算法运行时间从O(3^k)改进到O(2.846^k)，加根树的算法运行时间从O(2.3431^k)改进到O(2.3391^k)，其中k是MAF的分量数。研究者认为该技术具有更广泛的应用潜力。
AI.keywords: 最大一致森林, FPT算法, 分支策略, 进化树, 系统发育学
AI.comments: 该研究在最大一致森林（MAF）计算方面取得了显著进展，通过创新的“分裂或分解”策略，显著提高了算法的效率。尤其是在处理未加根树和加根树时，运行时间的改进是重要的理论贡献。然而，该方法在实际大规模数据集上的表现仍需进一步验证。此外，虽然提到了该技术可能广泛应用于其他算法系统发育学问题，但具体的应用场景和效果有待探索。

title: Strongly-polynomial time and validation analysis of policy gradient methods
summary: This paper proposes a novel termination criterion, termed the advantage gap function, for finite state and action Markov decision processes (MDP) and reinforcement learning (RL). By incorporating this advantage gap function into the design of step size rules and deriving a new linear rate of convergence that is independent of the stationary state distribution of the optimal policy, we demonstrate that policy gradient methods can solve MDPs in strongly-polynomial time. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first time that such strong convergence properties have been established for policy gradient methods. Moreover, in the stochastic setting, where only stochastic estimates of policy gradients are available, we show that the advantage gap function provides close approximations of the optimality gap for each individual state and exhibits a sublinear rate of convergence at every state. The advantage gap function can be easily estimated in the stochastic case, and when coupled with easily computable upper bounds on policy values, they provide a convenient way to validate the solutions generated by policy gradient methods. Therefore, our developments offer a principled and computable measure of optimality for RL, whereas current practice tends to rely on algorithm-to-algorithm or baselines comparisons with no certificate of optimality.

AI.title_translation: 策略梯度方法的强多项式时间与验证分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种优势差距函数作为终止准则，并证明策略梯度方法可以在强多项式时间内解决MDPs，同时在随机设定下提供优化性验证。
AI.motivation: 当前强化学习实践缺乏原则性和可计算的优化性度量，通常依赖算法间或基线比较，没有优化性证明。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新的终止准则——优势差距函数，并将其融入步长规则设计中。推导了一个独立于最优策略平稳状态分布的线性收敛速度。在随机设定下，展示优势差距函数能提供最优性差距的近似，并与易于计算的策略值上界结合，用于验证策略梯度方法的解。
AI.result: 策略梯度方法可以在强多项式时间内解决MDPs，这是首次为此类方法建立强收敛性。在随机设定下，优势差距函数为每个状态提供了最优性差距的近似，并表现出次线性收敛速度。优势差距函数与策略值上界结合，提供了一种方便的验证策略梯度方法解的方式。
AI.conclusion: 本文的进展为强化学习提供了一种原则性和可计算的优化性度量，填补了当前实践中缺乏优化性证明的空白。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新颖的终止准则，称为优势差距函数，用于有限状态和动作的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）和强化学习（RL）。通过将这种优势差距函数纳入步长规则的设计，并推导出一个独立于最优策略平稳状态分布的新的线性收敛速度，我们证明了策略梯度方法可以在强多项式时间内解决MDPs。据我们所知，这是首次为策略梯度方法建立如此强的收敛性。此外，在随机设定下，即只有策略梯度的随机估计可用时，我们表明优势差距函数为每个独立状态提供了最优性差距的紧密近似，并在每个状态下表现出次线性收敛速度。优势差距函数在随机情况下易于估计，并且当与易于计算的策略值上界结合时，它们提供了一种方便的方式来验证策略梯度方法生成的解。因此，我们的发展为强化学习提供了一种原则性和可计算的优化性度量，而当前的实践往往依赖于算法之间或与基线的比较，没有优化性证明。
AI.summary: 本文引入优势差距函数作为有限MDP和RL的终止准则，并将其应用于步长规则设计。研究表明，策略梯度方法能以强多项式时间解决MDPs，并首次证明了其强收敛性。在随机设定下，优势差距函数能近似最优性差距并实现次线性收敛，且结合策略值上界可用于验证解的优化性。这为RL提供了一种可计算的优化性度量。
AI.keywords: 策略梯度方法,优势差距函数,强多项式时间,收敛性,优化性验证
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入优势差距函数，为策略梯度方法在理论上提供了一个重要进展，首次证明了其强多项式时间收敛性。它不仅解决了当前RL实践中缺乏优化性度量的问题，还提供了一种可计算的验证方法，对于推动RL理论和实践的发展具有重要意义。

title: Multilevel Picard approximations and deep neural networks with ReLU, leaky ReLU, and softplus activation overcome the curse of dimensionality when approximating semilinear parabolic partial differential equations in $L^p$-sense
summary: We prove that multilevel Picard approximations and deep neural networks with ReLU, leaky ReLU, and softplus activation are capable of approximating solutions of semilinear Kolmogorov PDEs in $L^\mathfrak{p}$-sense, $\mathfrak{p}\in [2,\infty)$, in the case of gradient-independent, Lipschitz-continuous nonlinearities, while the computational effort of the multilevel Picard approximations and the required number of parameters in the neural networks grow at most polynomially in both dimension $d\in \mathbb{N}$ and reciprocal of the prescribed accuracy $ε$.

AI.title_translation: 多层Picard近似和具有ReLU、leaky ReLU和softplus激活函数的深度神经网络在$L^p$意义下逼近半线性抛物型偏微分方程克服了维度灾难
AI.tldr: 多层Picard近似和特定激活函数的深度神经网络在高维半线性抛物型PDE的$L^p$近似中克服了维度灾难，计算复杂度是多项式的。
AI.motivation: 解决半线性Kolmogorov偏微分方程（PDE）中存在的维度灾难问题。
AI.method: 使用多层Picard近似和具有ReLU、leaky ReLU或softplus激活函数的深度神经网络来逼近解。
AI.result: 证明了多层Picard近似和具有特定激活函数的深度神经网络能够在$L^\mathfrak{p}$意义下逼近解，且计算努力和所需参数数量最多以$d$和$1/\epsilon$的多项式速度增长。
AI.translation: 我们证明了多层Picard近似和具有ReLU、leaky ReLU和softplus激活函数的深度神经网络能够在$L^\mathfrak{p}$意义下逼近半线性Kolmogorov偏微分方程的解，其中 $\mathfrak{p}\in [2,\infty)$，在梯度无关、Lipschitz连续非线性的情况下，并且多层Picard近似的计算努力和所需神经网络参数的数量最多以维度 $d\in \mathbb{N}$ 和所需精度 $ε$ 的倒数的二者多项式方式增长。
AI.summary: 本文证明了多层Picard近似和使用ReLU、leaky ReLU或softplus激活函数的深度神经网络，能够以克服维度灾难的方式，在$L^\mathfrak{p}$意义下逼近梯度无关、Lipschitz连续非线性项的半线性Kolmogorov偏微分方程的解，其计算成本和模型规模仅随维度和精度的倒数呈多项式增长。
AI.keywords: Picard近似, 深度神经网络, 维度灾难, 偏微分方程, $L^p$近似
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于证明了多层Picard近似和特定激活函数的深度神经网络能够在$L^p$意义下克服高维半线性抛物型偏微分方程（特别是Kolmogorov PDE）的维度灾难。它表明计算复杂度和模型规模仅与维度$d$和精度$\epsilon$成多项式关系，这在解决高维问题时具有重要意义。限制在于仅考虑了梯度无关、Lipschitz连续的非线性项。

title: Robotics Meets Software Engineering: A First Look at the Robotics Discussions on Stackoverflow
summary:
Robots can greatly enhance human capabilities, yet their development presents a range of challenges. This collaborative study, conducted by a team of software engineering and robotics researchers, seeks to identify the challenges encountered by robot developers by analyzing questions posted on StackOverflow. We created a filtered dataset of 500 robotics-related questions and examined their characteristics, comparing them with randomly selected questions from the platform. Our findings indicate that the small size of the robotics community limits the visibility of these questions, resulting in fewer responses. While the number of robotics questions has been steadily increasing, they remain less popular than the average question and answer on StackOverflow. This underscores the importance of research that focuses on the challenges faced by robotics practitioners.
  Consequently, we conducted a thematic analysis of the 500 robotics questions to uncover common inquiry patterns. We identified 11 major themes, with questions about robot movement being the most frequent. Our analysis of yearly trends revealed that certain themes, such as Specifications, were prominent from 2009 to 2014 but have since diminished in relevance. In contrast, themes like Moving, Actuator, and Remote have consistently dominated discussions over the years. These findings suggest that challenges in robotics may vary over time.
  Notably, the majority of robotics questions are framed as How questions, rather than Why or What questions, revealing the lack of enough resources for the practitioners. These insights can help guide researchers and educators in developing effective and timely educational materials for robotics practitioners.

AI.title_translation: 机器人学与软件工程的交汇：初探StackOverflow上的机器人学讨论
AI.tldr: 该研究分析了StackOverflow上机器人学相关问题，发现机器人社区规模小导致问题可见度低、回复少，且开发者面临资源不足和随时间变化的挑战。
AI.motivation: 机器人开发面临诸多挑战，本研究旨在通过分析StackOverflow上的问题来识别机器人开发人员遇到的挑战。
AI.method: 研究团队创建了一个包含500个机器人学相关问题的过滤数据集，并将其与随机选择的问题进行比较。随后对这500个问题进行了主题分析，以揭示常见的查询模式。
AI.result: 机器人社区规模小限制了问题的可见度，导致回复较少。机器人学问题数量稳步增长但受欢迎程度低于平均水平。识别出11个主要主题，其中关于机器人运动的问题最常见。某些主题（如“规范”）在2009-2014年突出，之后相关性下降，而“移动”、“执行器”和“远程”等主题则持续占据主导地位。大多数机器人学问题是“如何”类问题，表明从业者缺乏足够资源。
AI.conclusion: 机器人学领域的挑战可能随时间变化。研究结果揭示了从业者缺乏足够资源，这些见解可以指导研究人员和教育工作者开发有效且及时的机器人学教育材料。
AI.translation:
机器人可以大大增强人类能力，但其开发面临一系列挑战。这项由软件工程和机器人学研究人员团队进行的合作研究，旨在通过分析StackOverflow上发布的问题来识别机器人开发人员遇到的挑战。我们创建了一个包含500个机器人学相关问题的过滤数据集，并检查了它们的特征，将其与平台上随机选择的问题进行了比较。我们的发现表明，机器人社区规模小限制了这些问题的可见度，导致回复较少。尽管机器人学问题的数量一直在稳步增加，但它们仍然不如StackOverflow上的平均问答受欢迎。这强调了关注机器人学从业者所面临挑战的研究的重要性。
因此，我们对500个机器人学问题进行了主题分析，以揭示常见的查询模式。我们确定了11个主要主题，其中关于机器人运动的问题最常见。我们对年度趋势的分析显示，某些主题，如“规范”，在2009年至2014年期间很突出，但此后其相关性有所下降。相比之下，“移动”、“执行器”和“远程”等主题多年来一直主导着讨论。这些发现表明机器人学中的挑战可能随时间而变化。
值得注意的是，大多数机器人学问题都被框定为“如何”问题，而不是“为什么”或“是什么”问题，这揭示了从业者缺乏足够的资源。这些见解可以帮助指导研究人员和教育工作者为机器人学从业者开发有效和及时的教育材料。
AI.summary: 本研究通过分析StackOverflow上的机器人学问题，探讨了机器人开发人员面临的挑战。研究发现，机器人社区规模小导致问题可见度低和回复少，尽管问题数量在增长，但受欢迎度不高。通过主题分析，识别出11个主要挑战主题，其中机器人运动最常见，且不同主题的重要性随时间变化。研究还指出，大量“如何”类问题表明机器人从业者缺乏充足的资源，这些发现对指导机器人教育材料的开发具有重要意义。
AI.keywords: 机器人学, 软件工程, StackOverflow, 开发者挑战, 主题分析
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地利用StackOverflow数据来分析机器人开发中的实际挑战，为软件工程与机器人学交叉领域提供了独特的视角。研究结果对于理解机器人社区的动态、识别开发瓶颈以及改进教育和资源支持具有重要意义。

title: Multi-Session Client-Centered Treatment Outcome Evaluation in Psychotherapy
summary: In psychotherapy, therapeutic outcome assessment, or treatment outcome evaluation, is essential to mental health care by systematically evaluating therapeutic processes and outcomes. Existing large language model approaches often focus on therapist-centered, single-session evaluations, neglecting the client's subjective experience and longitudinal progress across multiple sessions. To address these limitations, we propose IPAEval, a client-Informed Psychological Assessment-based Evaluation framework, which automates treatment outcome evaluations from the client's perspective using clinical interviews. It integrates cross-session client-contextual assessment and session-focused client-dynamics assessment for a comprehensive understanding of therapeutic progress. Specifically, IPAEval employs a two-stage prompt scheme that maps client information onto psychometric test items, enabling interpretable and structured psychological assessments. Experiments on our new TheraPhase dataset, comprising 400 paired initial and completion stage client records, demonstrate that IPAEval effectively tracks symptom severity and treatment outcomes over multiple sessions, outperforming baseline approaches across both closed-source and open-source models, and validating the benefits of items-aware reasoning mechanisms.

AI.title_translation: 心理治疗中多会话、以客户为中心的治疗结果评估
AI.tldr: 为解决现有心理治疗效果评估忽略客户主观感受和长期进展的问题，研究人员开发了 IPAEval 框架。该框架以客户为中心，通过整合多会话信息和使用特殊的两阶段提示方案，能更准确、更全面地自动化评估治疗结果，并在数据集上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于大型语言模型的方法通常侧重于以治疗师为中心、单次会话的评估，忽略了客户的主观体验和跨多个会话的纵向进展。
AI.method: IPAEval，一个基于客户知情心理评估（IPA）的评估框架。它采用两阶段提示方案，将客户信息映射到心理测量测试项目上，整合了跨会话客户背景评估和聚焦会话的客户动态评估。
AI.result: 在新的 TheraPhase 数据集（包含 400 对初始和完成阶段的客户记录）上进行实验，证明 IPAEval 有效追踪症状严重程度和治疗结果，并在闭源和开源模型上均优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: IPAEval 能够有效追踪跨多个会话的症状严重程度和治疗结果，优于基线方法，并验证了感知项目推理机制的益处。
AI.translation: 在心理治疗中，治疗结果评估或治疗效果评估对心理健康护理至关重要，它通过系统地评估治疗过程和结果来实现。现有的许多大型语言模型方法通常侧重于以治疗师为中心、单次会话的评估，而忽略了客户的主观体验和跨多个会话的纵向进展。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了 IPAEval，一个基于客户知情心理评估（IPA）的评估框架，它利用临床访谈从客户的角度自动进行治疗结果评估。它整合了跨会话的客户背景评估和聚焦会话的客户动态评估，以全面理解治疗进展。具体来说，IPAEval 采用两阶段提示方案，将客户信息映射到心理测量测试项目上，从而实现可解释和结构化的心理评估。我们在新的 TheraPhase 数据集上进行了实验，该数据集包含 400 对初始和完成阶段的客户记录，实验证明 IPAEval 能有效追踪跨多个会话的症状严重程度和治疗结果，在闭源和开源模型上均优于基线方法，并验证了感知项目推理机制的益处。
AI.summary: 本研究提出 IPAEval 框架，旨在解决现有心理治疗结果评估中以治疗师为中心和单次评估的局限性。IPAEval 通过整合跨会话背景和会话内动态评估，实现了从客户角度对治疗效果的自动化评估，并通过两阶段提示方案将信息映射到测试项目上，实验证明其在追踪长期治疗效果方面优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 心理治疗, 治疗结果评估, 客户中心, 大型语言模型, 跨会话评估
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于提出了一个以客户为中心的、整合了跨会话背景和会话内动态评估的框架（IPAEval），解决了现有方法侧重于治疗师中心和单次评估的局限性。其重要性在于为心理治疗效果的自动化、客观化评估提供了一种新的、更贴近客户主观体验的工具。局限性可能在于模型对临床访谈数据的依赖性以及评估的泛化能力。

title: Meta-Transfer Learning Powered Temporal Graph Networks for Cross-City Real Estate Appraisal
summary: Real estate appraisal is important for a variety of endeavors such as real estate deals, investment analysis, and real property taxation. Recently, deep learning has shown great promise for real estate appraisal by harnessing substantial online transaction data from web platforms. Nonetheless, deep learning is data-hungry, and thus it may not be trivially applicable to enormous small cities with limited data. To this end, we propose Meta-Transfer Learning Powered Temporal Graph Networks (MetaTransfer) to transfer valuable knowledge from multiple data-rich metropolises to the data-scarce city to improve valuation performance. Specifically, by modeling the ever-growing real estate transactions with associated residential communities as a temporal event heterogeneous graph, we first design an Event-Triggered Temporal Graph Network to model the irregular spatiotemporal correlations between evolving real estate transactions. Besides, we formulate the city-wide real estate appraisal as a multi-task dynamic graph link label prediction problem, where the valuation of each community in a city is regarded as an individual task. A Hypernetwork-Based Multi-Task Learning module is proposed to simultaneously facilitate intra-city knowledge sharing between multiple communities and task-specific parameters generation to accommodate the community-wise real estate price distribution. Furthermore, we propose a Tri-Level Optimization Based Meta- Learning framework to adaptively re-weight training transaction instances from multiple source cities to mitigate negative transfer, and thus improve the cross-city knowledge transfer effectiveness. Finally, extensive experiments based on five real-world datasets demonstrate the significant superiority of MetaTransfer compared with eleven baseline algorithms.

AI.title_translation: 元迁移学习赋能的时间图网络用于跨城市房地产评估
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为MetaTransfer的新模型，利用元迁移学习和时间图网络来解决数据稀疏城市中的房地产估值问题。该模型通过从数据丰富的城市迁移知识，并设计了事件触发的时间图网络和基于超网络的تمر任务学习模块来处理时空相关性和跨社区知识共享，最终在实验中证明了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在房地产估值方面显示出巨大潜力，但其对数据的需求限制了其在数据稀疏的小城市中的应用。因此，需要一种方法将数据丰富的大都市的宝贵知识迁移到数据稀缺的城市，以提高估值性能。
AI.method: 1. 将房地产交易及其关联的社区建模为时间事件异构图。 2. 设计事件触发的时间图网络（Event-Triggered Temporal Graph Network）来捕捉房地产交易中不规则的时空相关性。 3. 将城市范围的房地产估值视为多任务动态图链接标签预测问题。 4. 提出基于超网络的多任务学习（Hypernetwork-Based Multi-Task Learning）模块，以促进城市内社区间的知识共享并生成特定于任务的参数。 5. 提出基于三层优化的元学习（Tri-Level Optimization Based Meta-Learning）框架，自适应地重新加权来自多个源城市训练的交易实例，以减轻负迁移并提高跨城市知识迁移的有效性。
AI.result: MetaTransfer模型在五个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验证明，其性能显著优于十一个基线算法。
AI.conclusion: MetaTransfer模型通过结合元迁移学习和时间图网络，有效地解决了数据稀疏城市中的房地产估值问题，显著提高了估值性能。
AI.translation: 房地产估值对于房地产交易、投资分析和房地产税收等多种活动都非常重要。最近，深度学习通过利用网络平台上的大量在线交易数据，在房地产估值方面显示出巨大潜力。尽管如此，深度学习需要大量数据，因此在数据有限的广大中小城市中可能并非易于适用。为此，我们提出了一种名为MetaTransfer（元迁移学习赋能的时间图网络）的模型，将多个数据丰富的特大都市的宝贵知识迁移到数据稀缺的城市，以提高估值性能。具体来说，通过将不断增长的房地产交易及其关联的住宅社区建模为时间事件异构图，我们首先设计了一个事件触发的时间图网络来模拟不断演变的房地产交易之间不规则的时空相关性。此外，我们将城市范围的房地产估值问题构建为一个多任务动态图链接标签预测问题，其中城市中每个社区的估值被视为一个单独的任务。我们提出了一个基于超网络的多任务学习模块，以同时促进多个社区之间的城市内知识共享，并生成特定于社区的参数，以适应社区级的房地产价格分布。最后，我们提出了一个基于三层优化的元学习框架，以自适应地重新加权来自多个源城市训练的交易实例，从而减轻负迁移，提高跨城市知识迁移的有效性。最后，基于五个真实世界数据集的广泛实验证明，MetaTransfer在与十一个基线算法的比较中具有显著的优越性。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为MetaTransfer的新型深度学习模型，用于解决数据稀疏城市中的房地产估值挑战。MetaTransfer结合了元迁移学习和时间图网络，通过将房地产交易建模为时间事件异构图，并利用多任务学习和元学习框架，有效地从数据丰富的城市迁移知识，以提高数据稀缺城市中的估值准确性。实验结果表明，该模型在真实世界数据集上表现优于现有算法。
AI.keywords: 房地产估值, 时间图网络, 元迁移学习, 多任务学习, 跨城市迁移
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法来解决房地产估值中的数据稀疏性问题，特别是在小城市中。通过利用元迁移学习和时间图网络，该模型能够有效地迁移知识并处理复杂的时空动态。然而，其在实际应用中的可扩展性和对不同城市房地产市场异质性的适应性仍有待进一步研究。

title: Instructional Text Across Disciplines: A Survey of Representations, Downstream Tasks, and Open Challenges Toward Capable AI Agents
comments: Pre-CoLI print. Accepted for publication in Computational Linguistics (MIT Press). Advance online publication. March 2026
summary: Recent advances in large language models have demonstrated promising capabilities in following simple instructions through instruction tuning. However, real-world tasks often involve complex, multi-step instructions that remain challenging for current NLP systems. Robust understanding of such instructions is essential for deploying LLMs as general-purpose agents that can be programmed in natural language to perform complex, real-world tasks across domains like robotics, business automation, and interactive systems. Despite growing interest in this area, there is a lack of a comprehensive survey that systematically analyzes the landscape of complex instruction understanding and processing. Through a systematic review of the literature, we analyze available resources, representation schemes, and downstream tasks related to instructional text. Our study examines 181 papers, identifying trends, challenges, and opportunities in this emerging field. We provide AI/NLP researchers with essential background knowledge and a unified view of various approaches to complex instruction understanding, bridging gaps between different research directions and highlighting future research opportunities.

AI.title_translation: 跨学科的教学文本：表示法、下游任务和开放式挑战的调查，旨在实现能够的人工智能代理
AI.tldr: 大型语言模型在遵循简单指令方面取得了进展，但在处理复杂、多步骤指令方面仍面临挑战。本研究系统地回顾了181篇相关论文，分析了复杂指令理解和处理的资源、表示方法和下游任务，为研究人员提供了背景知识和统一的视角，并指出了未来的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的任务通常涉及复杂的、多步骤的指令，这对当前自然语言处理系统来说仍然是一个挑战。为了在机器人、业务自动化和交互式系统等领域部署能够用自然语言编程以执行复杂、现实世界任务的通用人工智能代理，必须对这类指令进行稳健的理解。然而，目前缺乏对复杂指令理解和处理进行系统分析的综合性调查。
AI.method: 通过对文献进行系统性回顾，分析了可用的资源、表示方法和与指令文本相关的下游任务。对181篇论文进行了研究，以识别该新兴领域的趋势、挑战和机遇。
AI.result: 本研究系统地回顾了181篇关于指令文本的论文，分析了其表示方法、下游任务和相关挑战，为研究人员提供了该领域的背景知识和统一的视角。
AI.conclusion: 本研究系统地回顾了181篇关于指令文本的论文，分析了其表示方法、下游任务和相关挑战，为研究人员提供了该领域的背景知识和统一的视角，并指出了未来的研究方向。
AI.translation: 近年来，大型语言模型在通过指令调优遵循简单指令方面展现出了有希望的能力。然而，现实世界的任务通常涉及复杂的、多步骤的指令，这对于当前的自然语言处理系统来说仍然是一个挑战。对这类指令进行稳健的理解对于将大型语言模型部署为通用代理至关重要，这些代理可以用自然语言进行编程，以跨越机器人、业务自动化和交互式系统等领域执行复杂的、现实世界中的任务。尽管对该领域的研究兴趣日益浓厚，但目前缺乏一个系统地分析复杂指令理解和处理领域的研究现状的综合性调查。通过对文献进行系统性回顾，我们分析了可用的资源、表示方法以及与指令文本相关的下游任务。我们的研究考察了181篇论文，识别了该新兴领域的趋势、挑战和机遇。我们为人工智能/自然语言处理研究人员提供了必要的背景知识和对各种复杂指令理解方法的统一视图，弥合了不同研究方向之间的差距，并指出了未来的研究机会。
AI.summary: 本篇论文对跨学科的教学文本进行了全面的调查，重点关注其表示方法、下游任务以及在实现能够的人工智能代理方面存在的开放式挑战。研究人员通过系统性地回顾181篇相关文献，分析了当前复杂指令理解和处理的现状，识别了该领域的趋势、挑战和机遇，旨在为人工智能/自然语言处理研究人员提供背景知识和统一的视角，以促进未来研究的发展。
AI.keywords: 指令调优,复杂指令,大型语言模型,自然语言处理,人工智能代理

title: A dual-pairing summation-by-parts finite difference framework for nonlinear conservation laws
summary: Robust and convergent high-order numerical methods for solving partial differential equations are highly attractive due to their efficiency on modern and next-generation hardware architectures. However, designing such methods for nonlinear hyperbolic conservation laws remains a significant challenge. In this work, we introduce a framework based on dual-pairing (DP) and upwind summation-by-parts (SBP) finite difference (FD) and discontinuous Galerkin (DG) finite element methods, aimed at achieving accurate and robust numerical approximations of nonlinear conservation laws. The framework ensures entropy consistency and features an intrinsic high-order accurate filter designed to detect and resolve regions where the solution is poorly captured or discontinuities are present. The DP SBP FD/DG operators form a dual pair of discrete derivative operators that collectively preserve the SBP property. Furthermore, these operators are constructed to be upwind, allowing them to incorporate dissipation within the elements themselves.This contrasts with traditional SBP and collocated DG spectral element methods, which typically induce dissipation solely through numerical fluxes at element interfaces. Our framework facilitates the systematic combination of DP SBP FD/DG operators with skew-symmetric and upwind flux splitting techniques. This integration enables the development of robust, high-order accurate schemes for nonlinear hyperbolic conservation laws.

AI.title_translation: 非线性守恒律的双配对求和分部有限差分框架
AI.tldr: 提出一种基于双配对和迎风求和分部有限差分/间断伽辽金的框架，用于稳健、高阶地求解非线性守恒律，该框架具有熵一致性和内在高阶滤波器，并在单元内部引入耗散。
AI.motivation: 设计用于非线性双曲守恒律的鲁棒且收敛的高阶数值方法是一个重大挑战，但此类方法因其在现代和下一代硬件架构上的效率而极具吸引力。
AI.method: 引入了一个基于双配对 (DP) 和迎风求和分部 (SBP) 有限差分 (FD) 和间断伽辽金 (DG) 有限元方法的框架。该框架确保熵一致性，并包含一个用于检测和解决解捕获不良或存在不连续区域的内在高阶精确滤波器。DP SBP FD/DG 算子形成一个离散导数算子对，共同保持 SBP 属性，并被构建为迎风，以便在单元内部引入耗散。该框架还促进了 DP SBP FD/DG 算子与斜对称和迎风通量分裂技术的系统组合。
AI.result: 该框架能够开发出用于非线性双曲守恒律的鲁棒、高阶精确方案。它通过在单元内部引入耗散来解决传统方法的局限性，并确保熵一致性和高阶滤波功能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的双配对求和分部有限差分框架为非线性双曲守恒律提供了一种系统、鲁棒且高阶精确的数值近似方法，通过其独特的算子构造和耗散机制克服了现有方法的挑战。
AI.translation: 鲁棒且收敛的高阶数值方法对于求解偏微分方程极具吸引力，因为它们在现代和下一代硬件架构上效率很高。然而，为非线性双曲守恒律设计此类方法仍然是一个重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个基于双配对 (DP) 和迎风求和分部 (SBP) 有限差分 (FD) 和间断伽辽金 (DG) 有限元方法的框架，旨在实现非线性守恒律的精确和鲁棒数值近似。该框架确保熵一致性，并具有一个内在的高阶精确滤波器，旨在检测和解决解捕获不良或存在不连续的区域。DP SBP FD/DG 算子形成一个离散导数算子对，共同保持 SBP 属性。此外，这些算子被构建为迎风，允许它们在单元内部引入耗散。这与传统的 SBP 和并置 DG 谱元方法形成对比，后者通常仅通过单元界面处的数值通量引入耗散。我们的框架促进了 DP SBP FD/DG 算子与斜对称和迎风通量分裂技术的系统组合。这种集成使得能够开发出用于非线性双曲守恒律的鲁棒、高阶精确方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于非线性守恒律的创新型双配对 (DP) 和迎风求和分部 (SBP) 有限差分 (FD)/间断伽辽金 (DG) 框架。该框架旨在提供高阶精确且鲁棒的数值近似，其特点是熵一致性、内在高阶滤波器，以及通过迎风 SBP 算子在单元内部引入耗散，这与传统方法在界面处引入耗散的方式不同。该方法通过与通量分裂技术的结合，能够开发出高效且鲁棒的非线性双曲守恒律求解方案。

AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了双配对 SBP FD/DG 算子，这些算子不仅保持了 SBP 属性，还能通过迎风设计在单元内部引入耗散，从而克服了传统 SBP/DG 方法仅在界面处引入耗散的局限性。此外，框架中集成的熵一致性和高阶滤波器增强了其处理非线性守恒律中不连续性的鲁棒性和准确性。这种系统组合为开发高效、高阶的数值方案提供了新的途径。

title: Training-Free Layout-to-Image Generation with Marginal Attention Constraints
summary: Recently, many text-to-image diffusion models have excelled at generating high-resolution images from text but struggle with precise control over spatial composition and object counting. To address these challenges, prior works have developed layout-to-image (L2I) approaches that incorporate layout instructions into text-to-image models. However, existing L2I methods typically require fine-tuning of pre-trained parameters or training additional control modules for diffusion models. In this work, we propose a training-free L2I approach, MAC (Marginal Attention Constrained Generation), which eliminates the need for additional modules or fine-tuning. Specifically, we use text-visual cross-attention feature maps to quantify inconsistencies between the layout of the generated images and the provided instructions, and then compute loss functions to optimize latent features during the diffusion reverse process. To enhance spatial controllability and mitigate semantic failures under complex layout instructions, we leverage pixel-to-pixel correlations in self-attention feature maps to align cross-attention maps and combine three loss functions constrained by boundary attention to update latent features. Comprehensive experimental results on both L2I and non-L2I pretrained diffusion models demonstrate that our method outperforms existing training-free L2I techniques, both quantitatively and qualitatively, in terms of image composition on the DrawBench and HRS benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 无需训练的布局到图像生成：带有边缘注意力约束
AI.tldr: MAC是一种无需训练的L2I方法，通过优化扩散逆过程中的潜在特征，利用注意力机制约束实现对图像布局的精确控制，并在基准测试中超越了现有无训练L2I方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像模型在精确控制空间布局和物体计数方面存在不足，现有的L2I方法需要对预训练参数进行微调或训练额外的控制模块。本文旨在提出一种无需额外模块或微调的训练-免费L2I方法。
AI.method: 提出MAC（Marginal Attention Constrained Generation）方法，这是一种无需训练的L2I方法。它利用文本-视觉交叉注意力特征图量化生成图像布局与给定指令之间的一致性，并在扩散模型的逆过程中计算损失函数来优化潜在特征。为增强空间可控性，利用自注意力特征图中的像素到像素相关性来对齐交叉注意力图，并结合受边界注意力约束的三种损失函数来更新潜在特征。
AI.result: 在DrawBench和HRS基准测试上，MAC在图像合成方面，与现有的无训练L2I技术相比，取得了定性和定量的优越性能。
AI.conclusion: MAC在DrawBench和HRS基准测试中，与现有的无训练L2I技术相比，在图像合成方面取得了定性和定量的优越性能。
AI.translation: 最近，许多文本到图像扩散模型在从文本生成高分辨率图像方面表现出色，但在精确控制空间组成和物体计数方面存在困难。为了解决这些挑战，先前的工作开发了将布局指令纳入文本到图像模型的布局到图像（L2I）方法。然而，现有的L2I方法通常需要对预训练参数进行微调或为扩散模型训练额外的控制模块。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种训练免费的L2I方法MAC（边缘注意力约束生成），它消除了对额外模块或微调的需求。具体来说，我们使用文本-视觉交叉注意力特征图来量化生成图像的布局与所提供的指令之间的一致性，然后计算损失函数以在扩散逆过程中优化潜在特征。为了增强空间可控性并减轻复杂布局指令下的语义失败，我们利用自注意力特征图中的像素到像素相关性来对齐交叉注意力图，并结合受边界注意力约束的三种损失函数来更新潜在特征。在L2I和非L2I预训练扩散模型上的全面实验结果表明，我们的方法在DrawBench和HRS基准测试的图像合成方面，无论是在定量上还是定性上，都优于现有的训练免费L2I技术。
AI.summary: 本文提出了MAC（Marginal Attention Constrained Generation）方法，一种无需训练的布局到图像（L2I）生成技术，用于解决现有L2I方法需要微调或额外模块的问题。MAC通过分析文本-视觉交叉注意力特征图来衡量布局一致性，并在扩散逆过程中优化潜在特征。它还利用自注意力图中的像素相关性来增强空间可控性。实验证明MAC在图像合成方面优于现有的无训练L2I方法。
AI.keywords: 布局到图像生成, 无训练, 边缘注意力约束, 扩散模型, 空间控制
AI.comments: 该方法的主要创新点在于提出了一种无需训练（training-free）的布局到图像（L2I）生成方法MAC，它通过优化扩散逆过程中的潜在特征，避免了对预训练模型的微调或额外控制模块的训练。其利用交叉注意力图量化布局不一致性并结合边界注意力约束优化潜在特征，有效提升了空间可控性。

title: Learn from Foundation Model: Fruit Detection Model without Manual Annotation
comments: 35 pages, 11figures, conference or other essential info
summary: Recent breakthroughs in large foundation models have enabled the possibility of transferring knowledge pre-trained on vast datasets to domains with limited data availability. Agriculture is one of the domains that lacks sufficient data. This study proposes a framework to train effective, domain-specific, small models from foundation models without manual annotation. Our approach begins with SDM (Segmentation-Description-Matching), a stage that leverages two foundation models: SAM2 (Segment Anything in Images and Videos) for segmentation and OpenCLIP (Open Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining) for zero-shot open-vocabulary classification. In the second stage, a novel knowledge distillation mechanism is utilized to distill compact, edge-deployable models from SDM, enhancing both inference speed and perception accuracy. The complete method, termed SDM-D (Segmentation-Description-Matching-Distilling), demonstrates strong performance across various fruit detection tasks object detection, semantic segmentation, and instance segmentation) without manual annotation. It nearly matches the performance of models trained with abundant labels. Notably, SDM-D outperforms open-set detection methods such as Grounding SAM and YOLO-World on all tested fruit detection datasets. Additionally, we introduce MegaFruits, a comprehensive fruit segmentation dataset encompassing over 25,000 images, and all code and datasets are made publicly available at https://github.com/AgRoboticsResearch/SDM-D.git.
comment: 35 pages, 11figures, conference or other essential info

AI.title_translation: 从基础模型学习：无需手动注释的水果检测模型
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为SDM-D的框架，利用基础模型（SAM2和OpenCLIP）进行分割和描述，然后通过知识蒸馏训练紧凑、高效的水果检测模型，无需手动标注，并在水果检测任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.motivation: 农业领域数据稀疏，难以训练有效的模型，本研究旨在利用基础模型解决这一问题，实现无需手动标注的水果检测。
AI.method: 该方法分为两个阶段：1. SDM阶段，利用SAM2进行图像分割，OpenCLIP进行零样本开放词汇分类。 2. 知识蒸馏阶段，将SDM训练的模型知识蒸馏到紧凑、边缘可部署的模型中，以提高推理速度和感知准确性。
AI.result: SDM-D在各种水果检测任务（物体检测、语义分割、实例分割）上表现出色，性能接近使用大量标签训练的模型，并且优于Grounding SAM和YOLO-World等开放集检测方法。此外，研究还发布了包含超过25,000张图像的MegaFruits数据集。
AI.conclusion: SDM-D框架成功地利用基础模型实现了无需手动标注的高效水果检测，并在性能上超越了现有方法，为数据稀疏领域的小模型训练提供了新的途径。
AI.translation: 近期基础模型在海量数据集上的预训练知识迁移能力取得了突破性进展，这使得在数据量有限的领域进行知识迁移成为可能。农业是数据量不足的领域之一。本研究提出了一个框架，用于在没有手动标注的情况下，从基础模型中训练有效的、特定领域的小型模型。我们的方法首先利用两个基础模型：用于分割的SAM2（分割一切图像和视频）和用于零样本开放词汇分类的OpenCLIP（开放对比语言-图像预训练）。在第二阶段，利用一种新颖的知识蒸馏机制，从SDM中蒸馏出紧凑、边缘可部署的模型，从而提高推理速度和感知准确性。该完整方法，称为SDM-D（分割-描述-匹配-蒸馏），在各种水果检测任务（物体检测、语义分割和实例分割）上表现出强大的性能，且无需手动标注。其性能几乎可以与使用大量标签训练的模型相媲美。值得注意的是，SDM-D在所有测试的水果检测数据集上都优于Grounding SAM和YOLO-World等开放集检测方法。此外，我们引入了MegaFruits，一个包含超过25,000张图像的综合性水果分割数据集，并且所有代码和数据集均可在https://github.com/AgRoboticsResearch/SDM-D.git公开获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为SDM-D的创新框架，旨在解决农业领域数据稀疏的问题。该框架利用基础模型SAM2和OpenCLIP进行图像分割和零样本分类，然后通过知识蒸馏技术训练出紧凑、高效且无需手动标注的水果检测模型。实验结果表明，SDM-D在多种水果检测任务上的性能优越，甚至超过了现有的先进方法，并发布了MegaFruits数据集以供社区使用。
AI.keywords: 基础模型, 水果检测, 知识蒸馏, 无需标注, SDM-D
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地结合了基础模型的强大能力和知识蒸馏技术，有效地解决了数据稀疏问题，尤其是在农业领域。其无需手动标注的特性大大降低了应用门槛。SDM-D在性能上的优势以及MegaFruits数据集的发布，为相关领域的研究和应用提供了宝贵的资源。未来的工作可以探索该框架在其他数据稀疏领域的应用潜力，以及进一步优化蒸馏过程以提升模型性能。

title: TPCL: Task Progressive Curriculum Learning for Robust Visual Question Answering
comments: Our source code is available at https://github.com/AhmedAAkl/tpcl
summary: Visual Question Answering (VQA) systems are notoriously brittle under distribution shifts and data scarcity. While previous solutions-such as ensemble methods and data augmentation-can improve performance in isolation, they fail to generalise well across in-distribution (IID), out-of-distribution (OOD), and low-data settings simultaneously. We argue that this limitation stems from the suboptimal training strategies employed. Specifically, treating all training samples uniformly-without accounting for question difficulty or semantic structure-leaves the models vulnerable to dataset biases. Thus, they struggle to generalise beyond the training distribution. To address this issue, we introduce Task-Progressive Curriculum Learning (TPCL)-a simple, model-agnostic framework that progressively trains VQA models using a curriculum built by jointly considering question type and difficulty. Specifically, TPCL first groups questions based on their semantic type (e.g., yes/no, counting) and then orders them using a novel Optimal Transport-based difficulty measure. Without relying on data augmentation or explicit debiasing, TPCL improves generalisation across IID, OOD, and low-data regimes and achieves state-of-the-art performance on VQA-CP v2, VQA-CP v1, and VQA v2. It outperforms the most competitive robust VQA baselines by over 5% and 7% on VQA-CP v2 and v1, respectively, and boosts backbone performance by up to 28.5%.
comment: Our source code is available at https://github.com/AhmedAAkl/tpcl

AI.title_translation: TPCL: 任务渐进课程学习用于鲁棒视觉问答
AI.tldr: TPCL通过考虑问题类型和难度，渐进式训练VQA模型，显著提高了VQA在IID、OOD和低数据环境下的泛化能力，并达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉问答 (VQA) 系统在分布偏移和数据稀缺下表现脆弱，并且在同分布 (IID)、异分布 (OOD) 和低数据设置下泛化能力差。这种局限性源于次优的训练策略，即不加区分地对待所有训练样本，不考虑问题难度或语义结构，导致模型容易受到数据集偏差的影响，难以泛化到训练分布之外。
AI.method: 本文提出了任务渐进课程学习 (TPCL) 框架，这是一个简单、与模型无关的框架，通过联合考虑问题类型和难度来构建课程，渐进式地训练 VQA 模型。具体而言，TPCL 首先根据语义类型（例如，是/否、计数）对问题进行分组，然后使用一种新颖的基于最优传输的难度度量来对问题进行排序。
AI.result: TPCL在不依赖数据增强或显式去偏差的情况下，提高了在IID、OOD和低数据机制下的泛化能力，并在VQA-CP v2、VQA-CP v1和VQA v2上取得了最先进的性能。它在VQA-CP v2和v1上分别比最具竞争力的鲁棒VQA基线高出5%和7%以上，并将骨干性能提升高达28.5%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的TPCL框架通过优化训练策略，即联合考虑问题类型和难度构建渐进式课程，显著提高了VQA模型在分布偏移和数据稀缺条件下的鲁棒性和泛化能力，无需依赖数据增强或显式去偏差，并取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 视觉问答 (VQA) 系统在分布偏移和数据稀缺下表现出众所周知的脆弱性。虽然以前的解决方案——例如集成方法和数据增强——可以单独提高性能，但它们未能同时在同分布 (IID)、异分布 (OOD) 和低数据设置下很好地泛化。我们认为这种局限性源于所采用的次优训练策略。具体来说，不加区分地对待所有训练样本——不考虑问题难度或语义结构——使得模型容易受到数据集偏差的影响。因此，它们难以泛化到训练分布之外。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了任务渐进课程学习 (TPCL)——一个简单、与模型无关的框架，它通过联合考虑问题类型和难度构建的课程，渐进式地训练 VQA 模型。具体而言，TPCL 首先根据语义类型（例如，是/否、计数）对问题进行分组，然后使用一种新颖的基于最优传输的难度度量来对它们进行排序。在不依赖数据增强或显式去偏差的情况下，TPCL 提高了在 IID、OOD 和低数据机制下的泛化能力，并在 VQA-CP v2、VQA-CP v1 和 VQA v2 上取得了最先进的性能。它在 VQA-CP v2 和 v1 上分别比最具竞争力的鲁棒 VQA 基线高出 5% 和 7% 以上，并将骨干性能提升高达 28.5%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了任务渐进课程学习（TPCL）框架，旨在解决视觉问答（VQA）系统在分布偏移和数据稀缺下的脆弱性及泛化能力差的问题。TPCL通过根据问题语义类型分组并利用基于最优传输的难度度量进行排序，构建渐进式课程来训练VQA模型。实验结果表明，TPCL无需数据增强或显式去偏差，显著提升了模型在IID、OOD和低数据环境下的泛化能力，并在多个VQA数据集上实现了最先进的性能，优于现有鲁棒VQA基线。
AI.keywords: 视觉问答, 课程学习, 鲁棒性, 分布偏移, 泛化能力
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个简单且与模型无关的课程学习框架TPCL，通过联合考虑问题类型和难度来优化VQA模型的训练策略。其重要性体现在无需复杂的集成方法或数据增强，仅通过改进训练流程就能显著提高VQA模型在各种复杂条件下的鲁棒性和泛化能力，并取得了显著的性能提升。

title: Efficient transformer adaptation for analog in-memory computing via low-rank adapters
summary: Analog In-Memory Computing (AIMC) offers a promising solution to the von Neumann bottleneck. However, deploying transformer models on AIMC remains challenging due to their inherent need for flexibility and adaptability across diverse tasks. For the benefits of AIMC to be fully realized, weights of static vector-matrix multiplications must be mapped and programmed to analog devices in a weight-stationary manner. This poses two challenges for adapting a base network to hardware and downstream tasks: (i) conventional analog hardware-aware (AHWA) training requires retraining the entire model, and (ii) reprogramming analog devices is both time- and energy-intensive. To address these issues, we propose Analog Hardware-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation (AHWA-LoRA) training, a novel approach for efficiently adapting transformers to AIMC hardware. AHWA-LoRA training keeps the analog weights fixed as meta-weights and introduces lightweight external LoRA modules for both hardware and task adaptation. We validate AHWA-LoRA training on SQuAD v1.1 and the GLUE benchmark, demonstrate its scalability to larger models, and show its effectiveness in instruction tuning and reinforcement learning. We further evaluate a practical deployment scenario that balances AIMC tile latency with digital LoRA processing using optimized pipeline strategies, with RISC-V-based programmable multi-core accelerators. This hybrid architecture achieves efficient transformer inference with only a 4% per-layer overhead compared to a fully AIMC implementation.

AI.title_translation: 用于模拟内存计算的高效Transformer适配：通过低秩适配器
AI.tldr: 为了解决在模拟内存计算（AIMC）上适应Transformer模型时，重新训练或重新编程硬件的成本高昂的问题，我们提出了AHWA-LoRA训练。它通过冻结AIMC权重并使用轻量级LoRA模块进行适应，使得Transformer能高效地部署和适应AIMC硬件，混合部署方案仅带来轻微开销。
AI.motivation: 在模拟内存计算（AIMC）上部署Transformer模型面临挑战，因为它们需要灵活性和适应性。传统的模拟硬件感知（AHWA）训练需要重新训练整个模型，而重新编程模拟设备既耗时又耗能，阻碍了AIMC优势的充分发挥。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为模拟硬件感知低秩适配（AHWA-LoRA）训练的新方法。该方法保持模拟权重作为固定的元权重（meta-weights），并引入轻量级的外部LoRA模块来同时实现硬件和任务适应性。最后，评估了一种结合AIMC瓦片延迟和数字LoRA处理的混合部署策略。
AI.result: AHWA-LoRA训练在SQuAD v1.1和GLUE基准测试上得到验证，展示了对更大模型的扩展性，并在指令调优和强化学习中显示了有效性。混合架构部署实现了高效的Transformer推理，与完全AIMC实现相比，每层仅有4%的开销。
AI.conclusion: AHWA-LoRA训练能够高效地使Transformer适应AIMC硬件和下游任务，并且该方法具有良好的可扩展性，在混合架构部署中，与完全AIMC实现相比，每层仅有4%的开销，实现了高效的Transformer推理。
AI.translation: 模拟内存计算（AIMC）为克服冯·诺依曼瓶颈提供了一个有前景的解决方案。然而，由于Transformer模型在不同任务中固有的灵活性和适应性需求，将其部署在AIMC上仍然具有挑战性。为了充分发挥AIMC的优势，静态向量-矩阵乘法的权重必须以权重固定的方式映射和编程到模拟设备上。这对将基础网络适应于硬件和下游任务提出了两个挑战：（i）传统的模拟硬件感知（AHWA）训练需要重新训练整个模型，（ii）重新编程模拟设备既耗时又耗能。为解决这些问题，我们提出了模拟硬件感知低秩适配（AHWA-LoRA）训练，这是一种高效地使Transformer适应AIMC硬件的新方法。AHWA-LoRA训练将模拟权重保持固定为元权重，并引入轻量级的外部LoRA模块以实现硬件和任务适应性。我们对SQuAD v1.1和GLUE基准测试验证了AHWA-LoRA训练，证明了其对更大模型的扩展性，并展示了其在指令调优和强化学习中的有效性。我们进一步评估了一个平衡AIMC瓦片延迟和使用优化流水线策略的数字LoRA处理的实际部署场景，该策略基于RISC-V的可编程多核加速器。这种混合架构实现了高效的Transformer推理，与完全AIMC实现相比，每层仅有4%的开销。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为AHWA-LoRA训练的新方法，用于高效地使Transformer模型适应模拟内存计算（AIMC）硬件。该方法通过固定模拟权重并引入外部低秩适配（LoRA）模块来解决静态权重在硬件和任务适应性上的挑战，避免了昂贵的整体再训练或设备重新编程。实验证明了该方法在基准测试上的有效性和可扩展性，并在混合部署中实现了高效推理。
AI.keywords: 模拟内存计算, Transformer, 低秩适配, 硬件感知训练, 权重固定
AI.comments: 该研究的主要创新在于将低秩适配（LoRA）技术与模拟内存计算（AIMC）的硬件约束相结合，提出了AHWA-LoRA训练方法，有效解决了静态模拟权重在适应新任务时需要重新训练或重新编程的难题。其重要性在于，它为在能效高的AIMC硬件上高效部署和适应大型Transformer模型提供了一条可行的路径。局限性在于，它引入了混合架构（AIMC与数字LoRA处理），性能提升是相对于完全AIMC实现的，实际的延迟和能耗优化依赖于优化的流水线策略。

title: Temporally Non-Uniform Cellular Automata: Surjectivity, Reversibility and Cyclic Behavior
summary: This work studies Temporally Non-Uniform Cellular Automata (t-NUCAs), a variant of non-uniform cellular automata, which temporally use two rules in a sequence during their evolution. The one-dimensional t-NUCAs, under finite as well as infinite lattices, are considered in this work. Surjectivity and injectivity of the t-NUCAs are studied. The reversibility of the t-NUCAs is also explored here. Finally, a study on the cyclic behavior of finite t-NUCAs is presented.

AI.title_translation: 时间非均匀元胞自动机：满射性、可逆性和循环行为
AI.tldr: 研究了交替使用两个规则的时间非均匀元胞自动机（t-NUCAs）的数学性质，包括其在不同格上的满射性、单射性、可逆性和有限情况下的循环行为。
AI.motivation: 研究Temporally Non-Uniform Cellular Automata (t-NUCAs)，作为非均匀元胞自动机的一种变体，该变体在演化过程中暂时顺序使用两个规则。
AI.method: 研究了一维t-NUCAs在有限和无限格上的满射性和单射性，并探讨了其可逆性以及有限t-NUCAs的循环行为。
AI.result: 研究了t-NUCAs的满射性和单射性，并探索了其可逆性。此外，还对有限t-NUCAs的循环行为进行了研究。
AI.translation: 这项工作研究了时间非均匀元胞自动机（t-NUCAs），它是非均匀元胞自动机的一种变体，在演化过程中暂时顺序使用两个规则。本文考虑了一维t-NUCAs在有限和无限晶格上的性质。研究了t-NUCAs的满射性和单射性。本文还探讨了t-NUCAs的可逆性。最后，介绍了对有限t-NUCAs循环行为的研究。
AI.summary: 本文研究了一维时间非均匀元胞自动机（t-NUCAs），该模型在演化过程中顺序使用两个规则。研究内容包括t-NUCAs在有限和无限格上的满射性、单射性、可逆性，以及有限t-NUCAs的循环行为。
AI.keywords: t-NUCAs,非均匀元胞自动机,满射性,可逆性,循环行为
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于研究了具有时间上非均匀性的元胞自动机（t-NUCAs），这是一种新的变体，通过在演化过程中交替使用两个规则来引入时间上的动态性。其重要性在于扩展了对非均匀元胞自动机性质的理解。摘要中没有明确指出局限性。

title: Lightweight Gaze Estimation Model Via Fusion Global Information
summary: Deep learning-based appearance gaze estimation methods are gaining popularity due to their high accuracy and fewer constraints from the environment. However, existing high-precision models often rely on deeper networks, leading to problems such as large parameters, long training time, and slow convergence. In terms of this issue, this paper proposes a novel lightweight gaze estimation model FGI-Net(Fusion Global Information). The model fuses global information into the CNN, effectively compensating for the need of multi-layer convolution and pooling to indirectly capture global information, while reducing the complexity of the model, improving the model accuracy and convergence speed. To validate the performance of the model, a large number of experiments are conducted, comparing accuracy with existing classical models and lightweight models, comparing convergence speed with models of different architectures, and conducting ablation experiments. Experimental results show that compared with GazeCaps, the latest gaze estimation model, FGI-Net achieves a smaller angle error with 87.1% and 79.1% reduction in parameters and FLOPs, respectively (MPIIFaceGaze is 3.74°, EyeDiap is 5.15°, Gaze360 is 10.50° and RT-Gene is 6.02°). Moreover, compared with different architectural models such as CNN and Transformer, FGI-Net is able to quickly converge to a higher accuracy range with fewer iterations of training, when achieving optimal accuracy on the Gaze360 and EyeDiap datasets, the FGI-Net model has 25% and 37.5% fewer iterations of training compared to GazeTR, respectively.

AI.title_translation: 通过融合全局信息的轻量级眼动估计模型
AI.tldr: FGI-Net是一种新的轻量级眼动估计模型，它通过融合全局信息来替代深层网络，实现了参数量和FLOPs的大幅减少（比GazeCaps少87.1%和79.1%），同时保持高精度并加快了训练收敛速度。
AI.motivation: 现有高精度眼动估计模型通常依赖于更深的网络结构，导致参数量大、训练时间长和收敛速度慢的问题。因此，需要开发一种轻量化且高效的模型。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为FGI-Net（Fusion Global Information）的新型轻量级眼动估计模型，该模型通过将全局信息直接融合到卷积神经网络（CNN）中，以有效弥补多层卷积和池化间接捕获全局信息的不足，从而降低模型复杂度。
AI.result: 与最新的眼动估计模型GazeCaps相比，FGI-Net在参数量和FLOPs上分别减少了87.1%和79.1%，同时在MPIIFaceGaze、EyeDiap、Gaze360和RT-Gene数据集上取得了较小的角度误差。此外，与CNN和Transformer等不同架构模型相比，FGI-Net能以更少的训练迭代次数快速收敛到更高的精度范围，并在Gaze360和EyeDiap数据集上分别比GazeTR少用了25%和37.5%的训练迭代次数。
AI.conclusion: FGI-Net模型在实现最优精度的同时，相比GazeTR减少了25%和37.5%的训练迭代次数，并在参数量和FLOPs上相对于GazeCaps实现了显著降低，证明了其在准确性、效率和轻量化方面的优越性能。
AI.translation: 基于深度学习的外观眼动估计方法因其高精度和较少的环境约束而越来越受欢迎。然而，现有高精度模型通常依赖于更深层次的网络，导致参数量大、训练时间长和收敛速度慢等问题。针对此问题，本文提出了一种新颖的轻量级眼动估计模型FGI-Net（融合全局信息）。该模型将全局信息融合到CNN中，有效弥补了多层卷积和池化间接捕获全局信息的需要，同时降低了模型的复杂度，提高了模型的准确性和收敛速度。为验证模型的性能，我们进行了大量的实验，将准确性与现有的经典模型和轻量级模型进行比较，将收敛速度与不同架构的模型进行比较，并进行了消融实验。实验结果表明，与最新的眼动估计模型GazeCaps相比，FGI-Net实现了更小的角度误差，同时参数量和FLOPs分别减少了87.1%和79.1%（MPIIFaceGaze为3.74°，EyeDiap为5.15°，Gaze360为10.50°，RT-Gene为6.02°）。此外，与CNN和Transformer等不同架构模型相比，FGI-Net能够在更少的训练迭代次数下快速收敛到更高的精度范围，在Gaze360和EyeDiap数据集上达到最优精度时，FGI-Net的训练迭代次数分别比GazeTR减少了25%和37.5%。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为FGI-Net的轻量级眼动估计模型，通过在CNN中融合全局信息来降低模型复杂性、提高准确性和收敛速度。实验证明，FGI-Net在参数量和计算量上大幅优于GazeCaps，并且收敛速度快于其他架构模型，同时在多个数据集上取得了优异的精度表现。
AI.keywords: 眼动估计, 轻量化模型, 全局信息融合, 卷积神经网络, 模型效率
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一种轻量化的网络结构FGI-Net，通过融合全局信息来替代深层卷积和池化操作，从而在保持高精度的同时显著降低了模型的复杂性和计算成本。其重要性在于为资源受限环境下的眼动估计提供了一个高效的解决方案。局限性是仅在少数几个公开数据集上进行了性能验证。

title: Monitoring access to piped water and sanitation infrastructure in Africa at disaggregated scales using satellite imagery and self-supervised learning
summary: Clean water and sanitation are essential for health, well-being, and sustainable development, yet significant global disparities persist. Although the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 6 clearly defines targets for universal access to clean water and sanitation, limitations in data coverage and openness impede accurate tracking of progress in many countries. To bridge these gaps, this study integrates Afrobarometer survey data, satellite imagery from Sentinel-2, and advanced deep learning techniques using Meta's self-supervised Distillation with No Labels (DINO) model to develop a modeling framework for evaluating access to piped water and sewage systems across diverse African regions. The modeling framework achieved notable accuracy, with over 84% for piped water and 87% for sewage system access classification. When combined with geospatial population data, validation against official statistics from the United Nations Joint Monitoring Program demonstrated high concordance at the national scale (R2 of 0.92 for piped water access and R2 of 0.72 for sewage system access). The national-level estimates can represent SDG Indicators 6.1.1 and 6.2.1. This approach provides policymakers and stakeholders with an effective, scalable, and cost-efficient tool to pinpoint underserved areas requiring targeted intervention. The methodology developed herein can be adapted for assessing other infrastructure-related SDGs, promoting enhanced monitoring and informed decision-making towards achieving global sustainability objectives.

AI.title_translation: 利用卫星图像和自监督学习在非洲的分解尺度上监测供水和卫生设施的接入情况
AI.tldr: 该研究结合了Afrobarometer调查数据、Sentinel-2卫星图像以及Meta的DINO自监督学习模型，开发了一个评估非洲供水和污水系统接入情况的模型框架。该框架在分类任务上达到了84%以上的准确率，并在国家尺度上与联合国官方统计数据高度一致（R²分别为0.92和0.72），能够有效监测SDG 6.1.1和6.2.1指标，为政策制定者提供了一个可扩展且经济高效的工具，以识别服务不足的地区。
AI.motivation: 全球在实现可持续发展目标6（普及清洁饮水和卫生设施）方面面临数据覆盖和开放性不足的挑战，阻碍了许多国家进展的准确跟踪。本研究旨在弥合这些差距，提供一种更精确、可扩展的监测方法。
AI.method: 本研究整合了Afrobarometer调查数据、Sentinel-2卫星图像，并利用Meta的自监督Distillation with No Labels (DINO)模型，开发了一个用于评估非洲地区供水和污水系统接入情况的模型框架。该框架结合了地理空间人口数据，并与联合国联合监测计划的官方统计数据进行了验证。
AI.result: 该模型框架在供水和污水系统接入分类任务上取得了超过84%和87%的准确率。在结合地理空间人口数据后，与联合国官方统计数据的验证显示，在国家尺度上，供水接入的R²为0.92，污水系统接入的R²为0.72，显示出高度的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出的方法能够有效、可扩展且经济高效地评估非洲供水和污水系统的接入情况，能够代表SDG指标6.1.1和6.2.1，为政策制定者提供了一个识别服务不足地区并进行针对性干预的工具。该方法还可以应用于其他基础设施相关的可持续发展目标，以加强监测和支持决策。
AI.translation: 清洁饮水和卫生设施对于健康、福祉和可持续发展至关重要，但全球范围内的巨大差距依然存在。尽管联合国可持续发展目标（SDG）6明确了普及清洁饮水和卫生设施的目标，但数据覆盖和开放性的限制阻碍了许多国家进展的准确跟踪。为了弥合这些差距，本研究整合了Afrobarometer调查数据、来自Sentinel-2的卫星图像以及使用Meta的无标签蒸馏（DINO）模型的先进深度学习技术，开发了一个用于评估非洲不同地区供水和污水系统接入情况的建模框架。该建模框架取得了显著的准确性，在供水接入和污水系统接入分类方面均超过84%。当与地理空间人口数据相结合时，针对联合国联合监测计划官方统计数据的验证显示，在国家尺度上具有高度一致性（供水接入R²为0.92，污水系统接入R²为0.72）。国家层面的估计可以代表SDG指标6.1.1和6.2.1。这种方法为政策制定者和利益相关者提供了一个有效、可扩展且经济高效的工具，以 pinpoint 服务不足的地区，从而进行有针对性的干预。本文开发的方法可以适应于评估其他基础设施相关的可持续发展目标，促进加强监测和知情的决策，以实现全球可持续发展目标。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用Sentinel-2卫星图像和Meta的DINO自监督学习模型，结合Afrobarometer调查数据，来评估非洲供水和污水系统接入情况的新方法。该方法在分类任务上准确率超过84%，并在国家尺度上与联合国官方数据高度一致（R²分别为0.92和0.72），能够有效监测SDG 6.1.1和6.2.1指标，为识别服务不足地区和制定干预措施提供了一个可扩展且经济高效的工具。
AI.keywords: 清洁饮水, 卫生设施, 卫星图像, 自监督学习, 可持续发展目标
AI.comments: 该研究通过结合卫星图像和自监督学习，有效地解决了传统数据收集在监测可持续发展目标（特别是清洁饮水和卫生设施）方面存在的局限性。其方法的创新性在于利用自监督学习模型处理大规模卫星数据，并将其与调查数据和人口数据相结合，实现了高精度的基础设施接入评估。该方法不仅在非洲地区取得了显著成果，而且具有广泛的应用潜力，可推广至其他地区和基础设施监测领域。然而，其在不同地理和社会经济背景下的普适性和鲁棒性仍需进一步验证。

title: 3DSceneEditor: Controllable 3D Scene Editing with Gaussian Splatting
comments: Accepted by WACV 2026, Project Page: https://ziyangyan.github.io/3DSceneEditor
summary: The creation of 3D scenes has traditionally been both labor-intensive and costly, requiring designers to meticulously configure 3D assets and environments. Recent advancements in generative AI, including text-to-3D and image-to-3D methods, have dramatically reduced the complexity and cost of this process. However, current techniques for editing complex 3D scenes continue to rely on generally interactive multi-step, 2D-to-3D projection methods and diffusion-based techniques, which often lack precision in control and hamper interactive-rate performance. In this work, we propose ***3DSceneEditor***, a fully 3D-based paradigm for interactive-rate, precise editing of intricate 3D scenes using Gaussian Splatting. Unlike conventional methods, 3DSceneEditor operates through a streamlined 3D pipeline, enabling direct Gaussian-based manipulation for efficient, high-quality edits based on input prompts. The proposed framework (i) integrates a pre-trained instance segmentation model for semantic labeling; (ii) employs a zero-shot grounding approach with CLIP to align target objects with user prompts; and (iii) applies scene modifications, such as object addition, repositioning, recoloring, replacing, and removal--directly on Gaussians. Extensive experimental results show that 3DSceneEditor surpasses existing state-of-the-art techniques in terms of both editing precision and efficiency, establishing a new benchmark for efficient and interactive 3D scene customization.

AI.translation: 三维场景的创建传统上既耗时又昂贵，需要设计者精心配置三维资产和环境。近年来，生成式人工智能（包括文本到三维和图像到三维方法）的进步极大地降低了这一过程的复杂性和成本。然而，目前编辑复杂三维场景的技术仍然依赖于通常是交互式的、多步骤的、二维到三维的投影方法以及基于扩散的技术，这些技术往往缺乏精确的控制，并且阻碍了交互式性能。在本研究中，我们提出了 3DSceneEditor，这是一种完全基于三维的范式，用于使用高斯喷溅（Gaussian Splatting）对复杂三维场景进行交互式、精确的编辑。与传统方法不同，3DSceneEditor 通过简化的三维管线运行，能够进行基于高斯的直接操作，以根据输入提示进行高效、高质量的编辑。所提出的框架（i）集成了预训练的实例分割模型进行语义标注；（ii）采用了基于 CLIP 的零样本对齐方法，将目标对象与用户提示相关联；（iii）直接对高斯进行场景修改，如对象添加、重新定位、重新着色、替换和删除。大量的实验结果表明，3DSceneEditor 在编辑精度和效率方面均超越了现有的最先进技术，为高效、交互式三维场景定制树立了新的标杆。

title: The MediaSpin Dataset: Post-Publication News Headline Edits Annotated for Media Bias
comments: 8 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables Accepted at AAAI ICWSM 2026 We updated the paper title from "MediaSpin: Exploring Media Bias Through Fine-Grained Analysis of News Headlines " to "The MediaSpin Dataset: Post-Publication News Headline Edits Annotated for Media Bias"
summary: The editability of online news content has become a significant factor in shaping public perception, as social media platforms introduce new affordances for dynamic and adaptive news framing. Edits to news headlines can refocus audience attention, add or remove emotional language, and shift the framing of events in subtle yet impactful ways. What types of media bias are editorialized in and out of news headlines, and how can they be systematically identified? This study introduces the MediaSpin dataset, the first to characterize the bias in how prominent news outlets editorialize news headlines after publication. The dataset includes 78,910 pairs of headlines annotated with 13 distinct types of media bias, using human-supervised LLM labeling. We discuss the linguistic insights it affords and show its applications for bias prediction and user behavior analysis.

title: PrecLLM: A Privacy-Preserving Framework for Efficient Clinical Annotation Extraction from Unstructured EHRs using Small-Scale LLMs
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in automated text annotation within natural language processing. However, their deployment in clinical settings is severely constrained by strict privacy regulations and the prohibitive computational cost of processing voluminous unstructured Electronic Health Records (EHRs). In this study, we developed a resource-efficient preprocessing technique that can be adopted in existing LLM procedures. This approach is particularly useful for smaller LLMs, which are often more accuracy-challenged, and forms a compact LLM framework optimized for local deployment in computational environments with stringent privacy requirements and restricted access to high-performance GPUs (PrecLLM). The preprocessing step includes both regular expressions (regex) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to extract and highlight key information from unstructured clinical notes. Pre-filtering long and unstructured texts enhanced the performance of smaller LLMs on EHR-related tasks. Evaluation was performed on two distinct cohorts: a locally curated private EHR dataset from the EPIC system for a Head and Neck Cancer (HNC) cohort, and the publicly available EHR dataset (MIMIC-IV). Using MIMIC-IV, we further compared PrecLLM against fine-tuned LLMs. Results demonstrated that PrecLLM substantially enhanced the performance of the original smaller LLMs in terms of sensitivity, specificity, and F1 scores, making it well-suited for privacy-sensitive and resource-constrained applications. This study offers optimized LLM performance for local, secure, and efficient healthcare applications, and provides practical guidance for clinical LLM deployment while addressing challenges related to privacy, computational feasibility, and clinical applicability.

title: Learning Hidden Physics and System Parameters with Deep Operator Networks
summary: Discovering hidden physical laws and identifying governing system parameters from sparse observations are central challenges in computational science and engineering. Existing data-driven methods, such as physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and sparse regression, are limited by their need for extensive retraining, sensitivity to noise, or inability to generalize across families of partial differential equations (PDEs). In this work, we introduce two complementary frameworks based on deep operator networks (DeepONet) to address these limitations. The first, termed the Deep Hidden Physics Operator (DHPO), extends hidden-physics modeling into the operator-learning paradigm, enabling the discovery of unknown PDE terms across diverse equation families by identifying the mapping of unknown physical operators. The second is a parameter identification framework that combines pretrained DeepONet with physics-informed inverse modeling to infer system parameters directly from sparse sensor data. We demonstrate the effectiveness of these approaches on benchmark problems, including the Reaction-Diffusion system, Burgers' equation, the 2D Heat equation, and 2D Helmholtz equation. Across all cases, the proposed methods achieve high accuracy, with relative solution errors on the order of O(10^-2) and parameter estimation errors on the order of O(10^-3), even under limited and noisy observations. By uniting operator learning with physics-informed modeling, this work offers a unified and data-efficient framework for physics discovery and parameter identification, paving the way for robust inverse modeling in complex dynamical systems.

title: Use of diverse data sources to control which topics emerge in a science map
comments: modifications from the peer review in metaror. the reviews are 10.70744/MetaROR.34.1.ea, 10.70744/MetaROR.34.1.rv1, 10.70744/MetaROR.34.1.rv2, 10.70744/MetaROR.34.1.rv3
summary: Traditional science maps visualize topics by clustering documents within a network, but they are inherently biased toward clustering certain topics over others. If these topics could be chosen, then the science maps could be tailored for different needs. In this paper, we explore the extent to which the topic bias of a science map can be changed by choosing different data sources to build the document network. We analyze this by evaluating the clustering effectiveness of several topic categories over two sources that are traditionally used for the creation of science maps (citations and text similarity) and six non-traditional data sources, which we found favor different kinds of topics: Health issues for Facebook users, biotechnology topics for patent families, government and social issues for policy documents, food topics for Twitter conversations, nursing topics for Twitter users, and geographical entities for document authors (the favoring in this latter source was particularly strong). Our results show that diverse data sources can be used to control topic bias, which opens up the possibility of creating science maps tailored for different needs.

title: Effectiveness of Distributed Gradient Descent with Local Steps for Overparameterized Models
summary: In distributed training of machine learning models, gradient descent with local iterative steps, commonly known as Local (Stochastic) Gradient Descent (Local-(S)GD) or Federated averaging (FedAvg), is a very popular method to mitigate communication burden. In this method, gradient steps based on local datasets are taken independently in distributed compute nodes to update the local models, which are then aggregated intermittently. In the interpolation regime, Local-GD can converge to zero training loss. However, with many potential solutions corresponding to zero training loss, it is not known which solution Local-GD converges to. In this work we answer this question by analyzing implicit bias of Local-GD for classification tasks with linearly separable data. For the interpolation regime, our analysis shows that the aggregated global model obtained from Local-GD, with arbitrary number of local steps, converges exactly to the model that would be obtained if all data were in one place (centralized model) ''in direction''. Our result gives the exact rate of convergence to the centralized model with respect to the number of local steps. We also obtain the same implicit bias with a learning rate independent of number of local steps with a modified version of the Local-GD algorithm. Our analysis provides a new view to understand why Local-GD can still perform well with a very large number of local steps even for heterogeneous data. Lastly, we also discuss the extension of our results to Local-SGD and non-separable data.

title: The Cost of Replicability in Active Learning
summary: Active learning aims to reduce the number of labeled data points required by machine learning algorithms by selectively querying labels from initially unlabeled data. Ensuring replicability, where an algorithm produces consistent outcomes across different runs, is essential for the reliability of machine learning models but often increases sample complexity. This paper investigates the cost of replicability in active learning using two classical disagreement-based methods: the CAL and A^2 algorithms. Leveraging randomized thresholding techniques, we propose two replicable active learning algorithms: one for realizable learning of finite hypothesis classes and another for the agnostic setting. Our theoretical analysis shows that while enforcing replicability increases label complexity, CAL and A^2 still achieve substantial label savings under this constraint. These findings provide insights into balancing efficiency and stability in active learning.

title: Rethinking Software Misconfigurations in the Real World: An Empirical Study and Literature Analysis
summary: Software misconfiguration has consistently been a major reason for software failures. Over the past two decades, much work has been done to detect and diagnose software misconfigurations. However, there is still a gap between real-world misconfigurations and the literature. It is desirable to investigate whether existing taxonomy and tools are applicable for real-world misconfigurations in modern software. In this paper, we conduct an empirical study on 772 real-world misconfiguration issues, based on which we propose a novel classification of the root causes of software misconfigurations, i.e., constraint violation, resource unavailability, component-dependency error, and configuration semantic misinterpretation. Then, we systematically review the literature on misconfiguration troubleshooting to study the trends of research and the practicality of the tools and datasets in this field. We find that the research targets have changed from system and infrastructure software to advanced applications (e.g., cloud service). In the meanwhile, the research on non-crash misconfigurations also has significant growth. Despite the progress, a majority of studies lack reproducibility due to the unavailable tools and evaluation datasets. In total, only ten tools and four datasets are publicly available. We analyze the trends of existing literature on misconfiguration troubleshooting, summarize the challenges that users are faced with, and highlight the suggestions to mitigate and diagnose software misconfigurations. We release the real-world dataset of misconfiguration issues for follow-up research.

title: A Real-Time System for Scheduling and Managing UAV Delivery in Urban Areas
summary:
As urban logistics demand continues to grow, UAV delivery has become a key solution to improve delivery efficiency, reduce traffic congestion, and lower logistics costs. However, to fully leverage the potential of UAV delivery networks, efficient swarm scheduling and management are crucial. In this paper, we propose a real-time scheduling and management system based on the ``Airport-Unloading Station" model, aiming to bridge the gap between high-level scheduling algorithms and low-level execution systems. This system, acting as middleware, accurately translates the requirements from the scheduling layer into specific execution instructions, ensuring that the scheduling algorithms perform effectively in real-world environments. Additionally, we implement three collaborative scheduling schemes involving autonomous ground vehicles (AGVs), unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), and ground staff to further optimize overall delivery efficiency. Through extensive experiments, this study demonstrates the rationality and feasibility of the proposed management system, providing practical solution for the commercial application of UAVs delivery in urban.

title: Automatic Construction of Pattern Classifiers Capable of Continuous Incremental Learning and Unlearning Tasks Based on Compact-Sized Probabilistic Neural Network
comments: A modified version appeared in the Proceedings of the AAIML-2026
summary: This paper proposes a novel approach to pattern classification using a probabilistic neural network model. The strategy is based on a compact-sized probabilistic neural network capable of continuous incremental learning and unlearning tasks. The network is constructed/reconstructed using a simple, one-pass network-growing algorithm with no hyperparameter tuning. Then, given the training dataset, its structure and parameters are automatically determined and can be dynamically varied in continual incremental and decremental learning situations. The algorithm proposed in this work involves no iterative or arduous matrix-based parameter approximations but a simple data-driven updating scheme. Simulation results using nine publicly available databases demonstrate the effectiveness of this approach, showing that compact-sized probabilistic neural networks constructed have a much smaller number of hidden units compared to the original probabilistic neural network model and yet can achieve a similar classification performance to that of multilayer perceptron neural networks in standard classification tasks, while also exhibiting sufficient capability in continuous class incremental learning and unlearning tasks.

title: C-HDNet: Hyperdimensional Computing for Causal Effect Estimation from Observational Data Under Network Interference
comments: Published at Social Network Analysis and Mining
summary: We address the problem of estimating causal effects from observational data in the presence of network confounding, a setting where both treatment assignment and observed outcomes of individuals may be influenced by their neighbors within a network structure, resulting in network interference. Traditional causal inference methods often fail to account for these dependencies, leading to biased estimates. To tackle this challenge, we introduce a novel matching-based approach that utilizes principles from hyperdimensional computing to effectively encode and incorporate structural network information. This enables more accurate identification of comparable individuals, thereby improving the reliability of causal effect estimates. Through extensive empirical evaluation on multiple benchmark datasets, we demonstrate that our method either outperforms or performs on par with existing state-of-the-art approaches, including several recent deep learning-based models that are significantly more computationally intensive. In addition to its strong empirical performance, our method offers substantial practical advantages, achieving nearly an order-of-magnitude reduction in runtime without compromising accuracy, making it particularly well-suited for large-scale or time-sensitive application

title: DesCLIP: Robust Continual Learning via General Attribute Descriptions for VLM-Based Visual Recognition
summary: Continual learning of vision-language models (VLMs) focuses on leveraging cross-modal pretrained knowledge to incrementally adapt to expanding downstream tasks and datasets, while tackling the challenge of knowledge forgetting. Existing research often focuses on connecting visual features with specific class text in downstream tasks, overlooking the latent relationships between general and specialized knowledge. Our findings reveal that forcing models to optimize inappropriate visual-text matches exacerbates forgetting of VLM's recognition ability. To tackle this issue, we propose DesCLIP, which leverages general attribute (GA) descriptions to guide the understanding of specific class objects, enabling VLMs to establish robust vision-GA-class trilateral associations rather than relying solely on vision-class connections. Specifically, we introduce a language assistant to generate concrete GA description candidates via proper request prompts. Then, an anchor-based embedding filter is designed to obtain highly relevant GA description embeddings, which are leveraged as the paired text embeddings for visual-textual instance matching, thereby tuning the visual encoder. Correspondingly, the class text embeddings are gradually calibrated to align with these shared GA description embeddings. Extensive experiments demonstrate the advancements and efficacy of our proposed method, with comprehensive empirical evaluations highlighting its superior performance in VLM-based recognition compared to existing continual learning methods.

title: Relative Entropy Methods for the Approximation of Reactive Trajectories
summary: Motivated by challenges arising in molecular simulation, we study reactive trajectories of the overdamped Langevin dynamics, i.e. trajectories observed as they pass from a set A corresponding to the reagents of a chemical reaction to a set B corresponding to the products. Reactive trajectories are known to have the same distribution as trajectories of the overdamped Langevin dynamics biased by a singular drift related to the committor function. In this work, we assess the effect of replacing the exact singular drift with an approximation based on an approximate committor function. We derive a convenient formula for the relative entropy between the distributions of exact and approximate reactive trajectories, and we propose a stochastic gradient descent method for minimizing the entropy to train an approximate committor function on the fly while computing reactive trajectories. We also devise a model assessment procedure for comparing the qualities of different approximations to the committor function based on the relative entropy.

title: Enhanced Structured Lasso Pruning with Class-wise Information
summary: Modern applications require lightweight neural network models. Most existing neural network pruning methods focus on removing unimportant filters; however, these may result in the loss of statistical information after pruning due to failing to consider the class-wise information. In this paper, we employ the structured lasso from the perspective of utilizing precise class-wise information for model pruning with the help of Information Bottleneck theory, which guides us to ensure the retention of statistical information before and after pruning. With these techniques, we propose two novel adaptive network pruning schemes in parallel: sparse graph-structured lasso pruning with Information Bottleneck (sGLP-IB) and sparse tree-guided lasso pruning with Information Bottleneck (sTLP-IB). The key component is that we prune the model filters utilizing sGLP-IB and sTLP-IB with more precise structured class-wise relatedness. Compared to multiple state-of-the-art methods, our approaches achieve the best performance across three datasets and six model structures on extensive experiments. For example, with the VGG16 model based on the CIFAR-10 dataset, we can reduce the parameters by 85%, decrease the FLOPs by 61%, and maintain an accuracy of 94.10% (0.14% better than the original). For large-scale ImageNet, we can reduce the parameters by 55% while keeping the accuracy at 76.12% (only drop 0.03%) using the ResNet architecture. In summary, we succeed in reducing the model size and computational resource usage while maintaining the effectiveness of accuracy.

title: RLHF in an SFT Way: From Optimal Solution to Reward-Weighted Alignment
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is crucial for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values. However, RLHF has been continuously challenged by its high complexity in implementation and computation consumption, specifically for online sampling-based methods like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Even with recent simplifications, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) that designs an offline implicit reward learning objective relying on pre-collected preference datasets, the problems of over-fitting and training instability remain hindering the alignment process from the expected optimal performance. To address the existing challenges, we propose a novel simplification of RLHF from the perspective of variational inference, called Variational Alignment with Re-weighting (VAR). Specifically, by directly minimizing the distribution gap between the learning LLM policy and the optimal solution of RLHF, we transform the alignment objective into an offline reward-driven re-weighted supervised fine-tuning (SFT) form, which only requires minor adjustment on the SFT loss to obtain noticeable improvement on training stability and effectiveness. In comprehensive evaluation benchmarks, our objective empowers LLMs to outperform offline alignments, demonstrating superior performance in both helpfulness and harmlessness metrics (avg. $\uparrow7.16\%$ than DPO). Meanwhile, when compared to online sampling methods, our method is also comparable even better while significantly reducing computational overhead and accelerating convergence speed (over $5\times$ faster than GRPO), suggesting our approach as an efficient and effective solution in bridging the gap between efficiency and performance in LLM alignment.

title: Community notes reduce engagement with and diffusion of false information online
comments: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences. Changes from prior arXiv version: title updated in response to reviewer comment; added robustness checks, permutation test, and expanded discussion; corrected software issue, leading to changes in magnitude of unconditional average effects by no more than 8% (no changes to statistical significance or direction)
summary: Social networks scaffold the diffusion of information on social media. Much attention has been given to the spread of true vs. false content on online social platforms, including the structural differences between their diffusion patterns. However, much less is known about how platform interventions on false content alter the engagement with and diffusion of such content. In this work, we estimate the causal effects of Community Notes, a novel fact-checking feature adopted by X (formerly Twitter) to solicit and vet crowd-sourced fact-checking notes for false content. We gather detailed time series data for 40,078 posts for which notes have been proposed and use synthetic control methods to estimate a range of counterfactual outcomes. We find that attaching fact-checking notes significantly reduces the engagement with and diffusion of false content. We estimate that, on average, the notes resulted in reductions of 46.1% in reposts, 44.1% in likes, 21.9% in replies, and 13.5% in views after being attached. Over the posts' entire lifespans, these reductions amount to 11.6% fewer reposts, 13.3% fewer likes, 6.9% fewer replies, and 5.5% fewer views on average. In reducing reposts, we observe that diffusion cascades for fact-checked content are less deep and less "viral," but not less broad, than synthetic control estimates for non-fact-checked content with similar reach. This structural difference contrasts notably with differences between false vs.\ true content diffusion itself, where false information diffuses farther, but with structural patterns that are otherwise indistinguishable from those of true information, conditional on reach.

title: Herglotz-NET: Implicit Neural Representation of Spherical Data with Harmonic Positional Encoding
comments: Keywords: Herglotz, spherical harmonics, spectral analysis, implicit neural representation. Remarks: 4 pages + 1 reference page, 4 figures (In Proc. SAMPTA2025, Vienna)
summary: Representing and processing data in spherical domains presents unique challenges, primarily due to the curvature of the domain, which complicates the application of classical Euclidean techniques. Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as a promising alternative for high-fidelity data representation; however, to effectively handle spherical domains, these methods must be adapted to the inherent geometry of the sphere to maintain both accuracy and stability. In this context, we propose Herglotz-NET (HNET), a novel INR architecture that employs a harmonic positional encoding based on complex Herglotz mappings. This encoding yields a well-posed representation on the sphere with interpretable and robust spectral properties. Moreover, we present a unified expressivity analysis showing that any spherical-based INR satisfying a mild condition exhibits a predictable spectral expansion that scales with network depth. Our results establish HNET as a scalable and flexible framework for accurate modeling of spherical data.
comment: Keywords: Herglotz, spherical harmonics, spectral analysis, implicit neural representation. Remarks: 4 pages + 1 reference page, 4 figures (In Proc. SAMPTA2025, Vienna)

title: UASTrack: A Unified Adaptive Selection Framework with Modality-Customization in Single Object Tracking
summary: Multi-modal tracking is essential in single-object tracking (SOT), as different sensor types contribute unique capabilities to overcome challenges caused by variations in object appearance. However, existing unified RGB-X trackers (X represents depth, event, or thermal modality) either rely on the task-specific training strategy for individual RGB-X image pairs or fail to address the critical importance of modality-adaptive perception in real-world applications. In this work, we propose UASTrack, a unified adaptive selection framework that facilitates both model and parameter unification, as well as adaptive modality discrimination across various multi-modal tracking tasks. To achieve modality-adaptive perception in joint RGB-X pairs, we design a Discriminative Auto-Selector (DAS) capable of identifying modality labels, thereby distinguishing the data distributions of auxiliary modalities. Furthermore, we propose a Task-Customized Optimization Adapter (TCOA) tailored to various modalities in the latent space. This strategy effectively filters noise redundancy and mitigates background interference based on the specific characteristics of each modality. Extensive comparisons conducted on five benchmarks including LasHeR, GTOT, RGBT234, VisEvent, and DepthTrack, covering RGB-T, RGB-E, and RGB-D tracking scenarios, demonstrate our innovative approach achieves comparative performance by introducing only additional training parameters of 1.87M and flops of 1.95G. The code will be available at https://github.com/wanghe/UASTrack.

title: TimeXL: Explainable Multi-modal Time Series Prediction with LLM-in-the-Loop
summary: Time series analysis provides essential insights for real-world system dynamics and informs downstream decision-making, yet most existing methods often overlook the rich contextual signals present in auxiliary modalities. To bridge this gap, we introduce TimeXL, a multi-modal prediction framework that integrates a prototype-based time series encoder with three collaborating Large Language Models (LLMs) to deliver more accurate predictions and interpretable explanations. First, a multi-modal prototype-based encoder processes both time series and textual inputs to generate preliminary forecasts alongside case-based rationales. These outputs then feed into a prediction LLM, which refines the forecasts by reasoning over the encoder's predictions and explanations. Next, a reflection LLM compares the predicted values against the ground truth, identifying textual inconsistencies or noise. Guided by this feedback, a refinement LLM iteratively enhances text quality and triggers encoder retraining. This closed-loop workflow-prediction, critique (reflect), and refinement-continuously boosts the framework's performance and interpretability. Empirical evaluations on four real-world datasets demonstrate that TimeXL achieves up to 8.9% improvement in AUC and produces human-centric, multi-modal explanations, highlighting the power of LLM-driven reasoning for time series prediction.

title: Desirable Unfamiliarity: Insights from Eye Movements on Engagement and Readability of Dictation Interfaces
summary: Transcripts displayed on dictation interfaces can be hard to read due to recognition errors and disfluencies. LLM-based text auto-correction could help, but changing the text during production could lead to distraction and unintended phrasing. To understand how to balance readability, attention, and accuracy, we conducted an eye-tracking experiment with 20 participants to compare five dictation interfaces: PLAIN (real-time transcription), AOC (periodic corrections), RAKE (keyword highlights), GP-TSM (grammar-preserving highlights), and SUMMARY (LLM-generated abstractive summary). By analyzing participants' gaze patterns during speech composition and reviewing processes, we found that during composition, participants spent only 7-11% of their time in active reading regardless of the interface. Although SUMMARY introduced unfamiliar words and phrasing during composition, it was easier to read and more preferred by participants. Our findings suggest a high user tolerance for altering spoken words in LLM-enabled diction interfaces.

title: Stratified Topological Autonomy for Long-Range Coordination (STALC)
comments: ©2026 IEEE. Personal use of this material is permitted. summary: In this paper, we present Stratified Topological Autonomy for Long-Range Coordination (STALC), a hierarchical planning approach for multi-robot coordination in real-world environments with significant inter-robot spatial and temporal dependencies. At its core, STALC consists of a multi-robot graph-based planner which combines a topological graph with a novel, computationally efficient mixed-integer programming formulation to generate highly-coupled multi-robot plans in seconds. To enable autonomous planning across different spatial and temporal scales, we construct our graphs so that they capture connectivity between free-space regions and other problem-specific features, such as traversability or risk. We then use receding-horizon planners to achieve local collision avoidance and formation control. To evaluate our approach, we consider a multi-robot reconnaissance scenario where robots must autonomously coordinate to navigate through an environment while minimizing the risk of detection by observers. Through simulation-based experiments, we show that our approach is able to scale to address complex multi-robot planning scenarios. Through hardware experiments, we demonstrate our ability to generate graphs from real-world data and successfully plan across the entire hierarchy to achieve shared objectives.
